tei:div.tei:p: gzugs 'gros sna tshogs sngar 'dri ma myong stabs dang*/ sa yul dod lugs kyis 'god tshul sa 'pho 'gyur dgos pa'i bslab bya rnams go dka' ba mchis par brten/ chab mdo'i lha dpon dang nged rang gnyis kyis sol tho zhib bkod byed dgos byung bas 'gor che tsam byung yang mthar/ yal 'dab brgya dang brgyad kyi zhal byang tshigs bshad sh+lau ka res khyab par gsar bskrun bcas legs par grub/ de mthar nged rang dang dgon pa'i slob dpon rags btus nyer lnga tsam gyis rab gnas kyi cho ga nyin gang bcas legs par mthar phyin/ chu bya lo'i dgun zla rwa bar mkhan chen dang sde dge bla ma mchod yon lhan rgyas ldan chos sde pho brang du/ a dran bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu chos gdan 'dren zhus par phebs/ der kho bo cag nas gsol ston mdun 'jog gzabs par bstabs/ de dus kyang mkhan chen gtsor bzhugs kyi lha khang rnams la rab gnas rgyas par mdzad pa'i gral du bsdad/ mi ring bar ldan shod dpon gyi 'bod par song*/ dpon mgon po rnam rgyal gyis 'di skad du/ 'di phyogs su rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bkod pa'i dpe rgyun dkon par mchis pas/ da lam chos rgyal dge dbang yab kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ khyod kyis bkod pa zhib rgyas lag bstar byas pa zhig gi rgyun gzugs pa cis kyang dgos tshul gleng byung ba ltar/ gza' tshes dge bar 'go brtsams te thang kha bzhi tsam gyi skya ris nged rang gi lag bstar bkod nas/ de 'phros rim gyi 'god rtsis kyis/ sa dkar du song nas shing khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi lo dar gyi bsnyen mtshams zhugs/ de skabs dbus lha tshe brtan pa bos nas gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol rgyur ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun bzang sku tshad mtho brgyad pa zhig bzor bcug nas/ gza' tshes dge bar gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs nas/ nang rten gzungs 'bul bla re dang mdun 'jog rigs dang bcas grub 'phral du rab tu gnas pa nyin gang pa zhig byas/

dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dpal ldan chos skyong ba'i sku bzhengs pa de'i kha ta gang dgos kyi grogs ldan byas/ skabs der sa dkar dgon gyi grwa pa 'ga'i ngor kye rdor rgyu lam gyi dbang dang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang nyung shas la phul/ srin dpon sa nas 'bod du byung bar song*/ der rjes gnang kha shas dang*/ rang gi slob bu dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho pa mtsho dus yol 'dug pa'i bem po bsreg chog byas/ rtse khog dpon tshe brtan par a dran dge slong gis 'gro dgos zhes bskul ba ltar phyin/ dpon rgan 'das pa la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur phyir bzlog dang*/ ro bsregs nas sāts+tsha'i sgrub pa bcas pa'i phan 'dogs bsgrubs/ mar lam sham sring du rab bkram drung pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pa nas 'bod du byung bar song*/ der rten rnams la rab gnas nyin gang ma dang mi g.yo dkar po sogs kyi rjes gnang gsum tsam phul/ 'bam le dgon du 'bod par phyin/ dge slong rnams la mgon dkar dang dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang dang*/ der 'dus pa'i khrom la 'byung 'dul dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang rnams byas/ 'dam thog dgon pas gtsug lag khang du bos/ der 'dus tshogs su mgon dkar rjes gnang dang lha khang phyi nang du rab gnas mdor bsdus byas/ byang chog dang bsngo rten byung ba rnams kyi re ba bskang*/ bsdang 'dzom gang du khrom tshogs la thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang byas/ shing phag gsar tshes su chos sde pho brang du gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon sogs bris/ de mtshams shig nas hor ma zur dang khang gsar khag 'khrugs pa shor ba'i dpung gi rgyab non du rgyal rong rgyal pos byas pa'i dmag g.yos chen po byung*/ de'i bar 'dum dang rgyab gnon gang 'tsham gyi ched du sde dge'i rdzong khag rnams kyi dmag dpung bkye ba'i tshe/

a dran dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'ang dmag la song ba'i rgyab brten gyi srung bar mtshams la 'dug dgos zhes zer ba bzhin du hor zla drug pa'i tshes lnga nas bzung ste/ dmag rnams yar 'khor ba'i bar du mtshams bsdad/ de dag gi skabs su rmi lam du bkra shis rdzas brgyad lag tu gtad byung ba sogs ltas dge ba byung*/ rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku nas klong chen mdzod bdun skor rnams par du brkos pa'i dkar chag ze chen rab 'byams pas brtsams pa bskur nas/ 'di bar du brko rung min dang sor bzhag chog pa byung tshe bzo bcos gang dgos zhu dag dang mjug tu smon lam bcas par dgos pa'i mi mngag gsung shog zhib rgyas bcas btang bas 'byor byung bar zhu dag dang*/ smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bzos nas phul/ sde dge sa skyong bla ma hor du rgya dpon lo yes mjal du byon pa'i rgyab brten gyi srung bar mtshams 'dug dgos bka' phebs pa bzhin mgon khang gta' gtor bzhag pa dang rigs byed ma'i bsnyen pa byas pas rmi lam du kha zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa dang*/ mi sha lag pa bza' ba sogs dngos grub thob pa'i ltas dge ba byung ngo*// hor zla bcu pa'i nang gi nub cig tu rje sa skya pa chen po'i sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa spyan shin tu rlon zhing gsal ba cung zad thur du gzigs pa'i nyams can gsal ba zhig dang*/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i sku mi gsal tsam zhig mjal ba rnams rmis/ gzhan yang sgra dpe'i glegs bam lag tu byung ba dang*/ sde dge tshang gi dpe mdzod kyi lde mig lag tu gtad byung nas dpe tshogs bltas pa sogs rmi ltas dge ba 'ga' zhig byung ngo*// dge bshes bsod nams rgyal mtshan par dgon khag gnyis kyi grwa pa dang kho bo bcas pas tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur stong phrag bsags pa'i grub pa'i nub mo ri gnyis kyi rtse nas nyi 'od thal song ba rmis pa sku tshe thung tsam las med pa'i rtags zhig 'dra snyam mo/

me byi lor ldan nas bteg ste lhun grub steng du 'ongs pa na/ sde dge bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa'i sku gdung gi sāts+tsha gzhug pa'i gser gdung bla ma sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pa'i gdung 'bum bcas bzo grub pa'i nang rten dang gzungs 'bul rnams byas mthar bla ma dge slong nyer lnga tsam dang lhan cig rab tu gnas pa nyin gcig pa zhig byas/ de mtshams nas rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhing khams su gshegs pa'i mdun chen la snyan gsan 'bul ba dang dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa kho bo btang chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus byung bar der 'gro chog pa'i bka' grol nas zla ba'i tshes la bteg rdzogs chen bzhugs gnas su gzims khang gsar bzos su slebs/ sku gdung gi mdun du rang gis mchod 'bul rten mdun 'jog dang*/ yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcas phul/ der 'phen gdugs bla re dang mchod chas phyi nang gi yo byad bkod pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ nyer spyod gsar bskrun gyi mchod 'bul kho na la bltas kyang rgyu bzang zhing bzo legs pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar rigs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan las grub pa'i zhing gi bkod pa la'ang 'di las ci zhig snyam pa'i mchod phreng bstar 'dug kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi sta gon rnams dang*/ phyi nyin sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug sngon du 'gro bas sku gdung nyi ma gnyis dang tha ma la dbang bzhi 'bul ba bcas dang bar gyi zhag lnga po la dus tha'i khrus chog tsam gyis zhabs 'degs zhus/ nged rang gis sngar nas 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi dbang rnams zhu 'dun chen po yod ltar/ der ze chen rab 'byams pa bzhugs pa dang stabs 'grig byung ba la zhus pas/ sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi dbang dang rjes gnang bka' gtad rnams nyin gsum gyis thams cad rdzogs par grub pa'i thugs rab shin tu yangs shing 'chad pa'i ro 'dzin ches bde ba'i ngo mtshar che rab kyi bka' drin byung*/

phyi nyin der rgya rong dpon po/ ze chen sprul sku/ 'brug pa sprul sku dang*/ a gar bla ma sogs kyis mtshon pa'i ser skya mang tsam la grub thob thang stong pa'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang dang*/ tshogs su gdon byar sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs shig dgos bskul ba brtsams pa'i lung bcas phul nas tshur 'khor/ gnyer pa blo gros brtan pa 'das pa'i 'pho ba smon lam sogs bgyis/ gzungs bkral gdugs dkar gyi dbang byas/ me glang lor dbus phyogs su mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i zhabs brtan du dgongs 'grel 'gyur ro cog shin tu rgyas pa bzhengs pa'i dus/ dbus phyogs kyi gdan sa rnams su btsal bas gsar du rnyed pa'i kha 'gengs kyi gras nas sde dge'i par ma 'dir phal cher chud par byas yod kyang*/ da dung po ti brgyad dgu tsam gyi phyi mo ma 'byor ba rnams gzhung sa nas g.yar po zhus nas par du brko ba zhig gnang na shin tu rgyas che bas legs tshul phul bar/ mdun lcam dral nas kyang dpal ldan chos skyong gdan 'dren pa zhu yig bcas phul nas/ dbus bar gyi phyi mo rang de g.yar gnang dgos zhus pa na/ de skabs rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho zhing phebs pa'i skabs su song bas/ ma phyi dngos min pa'i dbus kyi bu dpe par ma po ti lnga tsam 'byor byung yang*/ par 'debs lugs nyes pa dang shog bu zhan pa sogs kyis mi gsal bas yi ge 'bru ngos mi zin pa mang du byung*/ de lta na'ang slar phyi mo par ma min pa'i gzhan zhig 'byor tshe bcos rgyu'i rtsis kyis par gzhi 'dri brkos byas yod kyang da ltar 'gro don phrin las 'byin nus med pa rdul khrod du brtsigs nas bzhag pa 'di rnams lags so// de dang mnyam du gyi na pa bdag gis rang dang skal mnyam gyi las dang po pa'i slob dpon dang*/ grwa rigs slob gsar rnams la phan pa'i phyir/

chos kyi brgyud pa'i thos yig rnams kyi kha 'gengs dang*/ 'don chog skor gyi gsal byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor dang*/ rten bzhengs rnams kyi dkar chag 'dod gsol/ 'phrin yig sogs nyer mkho sug bris su byas pa nyung shas mchis pa rnams kyang*/ par du brko ba zhig byung na/ gsar bu dpe tshogs mi 'dzom pa 'ga' la phan 'dogs 'byung las che zhes gsol ba na/ chos ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po nyid nas de 'dras gzhan la phan 'dogs 'byung 'gro bas par du brko bar gyis zhes bka' stsal phebs pa ltar/ zhar byung de dag kyang 'dri ba'i zhu dag bcas par khang gi steng du gser gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi dang rma bya'i gzugs brnyan rnams 'dzugs pa'i gzungs 'bul dang*/ rab gnas kyi cho ga rnams byas/ dpal spungs nas si tu rin po che'i sku dpon karma rin chen mgon po zhing khams gshegs pa'i sar 'bod du byung bar bteg te zhag gsum steng nas zhag bdun gyi bar kun rig gi cho ga rnams dang lhan cig 'da' ka ma'i gsal 'debs phyir bzlog dbang bskur bcas dang*/ kho bos kye rdo rje la brten pa dang*/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros pas kun rig la brten pa'i sku gdung gi zhugs 'bul bcas pa'i zhabs 'degs zhus/ sa stag lor ngor e waṃ chos ldan nas mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong pa nyid ljongs 'di'i bstan 'gro'i mgon du spyan 'dren zhus pa bzhin phebs grub byung na'ang*/ sku la snyung bab lci mos zin pa'i rnam pa can du bstan gda'/ phyi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nub mo'i rmi lam du/ nged rang ngor thar pa rtse'i bla brang gi rdo cal gseb nas yar song bar gzims khang gzi mdangs 'bar ba/ de'i nang du sa skya gong mas phyi rol mdzad dus kyi bzhugs khri/ sa 'jal li'i rgya khri rgyab yol bcas yod pa de 'dra la/ bzo rgyu thams cad lcags las byas pa zhig gi steng na/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa nyid sa zhu chos gos bcas sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa zhig bdag la dgyes tshul mdzad pa yang yang rmis/

de'i phyi nyin mkhan chen pa'i sku mdun slebs pa na/ lha ris bas thang kha'i ras gzhi brgyangs pa zhig bzung 'dug par/ mkhan chen pa'i zhal nas da res rten 'brel bzang*/ zhu chen pas 'dir dpal mgon stag zhon gyi sku zhig 'dri bsam pas khyod kyis sol tho rgyobs gsung byung bar bdag gis de 'phral du skya ris byed rgyu byung bar/ thar rtse mkhan chen de nyid dpal mgon stag zhon sku dang grib ma ltar 'go ba'i rtags su go ba'i ngo mtshar skyes so// gzims chung phugs su bzhugs su gsol rgyu'i bla ma don yod grub pa'i sku mi tshad yod pa cig khyod kyis kha ta gyis la dbus lha rnams la bzor chug ces gsungs pa de'ang grub 'dug pas tshes bcu gsum la gzungs 'bul byas nas gzims chung phugs su gdan drangs nas/ 'di yon mchod thams cad nyams chag gso rten yin gsung*/ de nas yon mchod dang zhal chems kyi bkod pa rnams stsal nas/ tshes bcu bdun la mdzad pa tha ma'i tshul bstan te kho bo'i zhal chems ltar thugs dam gsal 'debs byed tshul cung zad zhus so// nyer zhi'i nam srod yol gyi dus su 'od gsal gyi klong nas bzhengs te sa gzhi rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba'i ltas dang bcas te dga' ldan byams pa'i zhabs drung du gshegs tshul bstan pa na/ gdung chas kyi zhabs phyi rnams kyang nged rang dang bla ma rab dkar ba/ ga zi lha ris pa bcas pas zhus nas/ mchod sprin dpag tu med pas mdun bdar te seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa khu dbon lcam dral bcas nas gtsug lag khang du dgung gsum pa'i stong chog mchod 'bul 'dzugs pa'i tshogs dbur 'bod par phyin/ sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i thig tshad bai ḍūr g.ya' sel nas bshad pa ltar cha 'grigs shing mdzes che ba mthong bas de ltar du gyang logs su thig btab nas shing bzor bcug hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer gcig smad shod du gnyer pa bo rgyal tshang gi khyim thab ma dus chos su yol bar 'bod du lhags pas der phyin/

dus 'das la kun rig gi phyir bzlog dbang zhag shas dang*/ rkyen sel du sbyin sreg kha shas blugs/ mkha' spyod byin rlabs dang*/ brag rdzong rjes gnang*/ tshe sgrub sogs spar rtsis bab pa'i dbang bka' gang dgos kyi re ba bskang*/ hor zla drug pa'i nyer lnga la mtshams 'og tu rgyal rong gi grwa pa rnams dang mjal phrad kyi dus byas kyang*/ de'i nub mor me chen mched cing tshogs zangs 'phyur ba'i 'ur zhogs chen po byung ba dang*/ yang lan cig bud med cig gis cho nge chen pos 'debs pa rmis pas mjal kha re zhig lhod par byas kyang*/ mi ring bar dbon bsod nams mchog grub rdo yul du byon pa bro 'tshal chen pos zin pa'i skad ngan byung ba de'i ltas su 'dra snyam ste/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes pa'i dbon chung rnam gnyis mkhyen rab gsal zhing bslab sbyangs kyi yul la brtson 'grus rgyun chags bzod pa bstan pa la sman 'dogs 'byung re che ba mchis mod/ gnyis ka bar chad rkyen dbang du yal song ba'i rjes mar dbang bskur dang 'da' ka'i gsal 'debs dang dgongs pa 'gengs byed kun rig gi cho ga sbyin sreg bcas pa'i zhabs 'degs zhus/ rgya dpon dge slong bkra shis rgya mtsho pa sku 'tsho'i dus las 'das pa'i rus bu'i sāts+tsha rnams la/ bsnyen song dge slong drug cu tsam dang lhan cig sāts+tshar rab gnas bsgrub pa bcas pa byas nas zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du si tu rin po che'i sku dbon mkhas grub chen po bla ma karma'i mtshan mnga' ngur smrig 'chang gi gzugs sku'i bkod pa zab dbyings su brtul pa'i bzhed dgongs 'gengs byed du 'bod par phyin nas zhag bcu skor tsam du bsdad de/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod phyir bzlog dbang bskur rnams kyi zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i tshogs bsags bzang po bsgrub rgyu byung ba dang*/ rgyal dbang karma pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'chang ba chen po dang*/

lnga rigs bstan pa'i snang byed si tu rin po che gdan 'dzom par 'tsho gzhes su phebs pa'i zhal bzang gi dkyil 'khor mjal ba dang gang ci'i gsung thos kyi skal ba bzang po myang ba mnyam du byung ngo*// 'tsho byed rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho 'dzin pa sku dbon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam gtan pa 'khor nyung shas bcas la grub thob lugs kyi tshe dbang dang thugs gsos phul/ gnang sbyin zab rgyas dang*/ mkhas dbang chen po'i bka' 'bum gras nas/ 'chi med mdzod 'grel gyi glegs bam stsal zhing*/ rim bzhin tsaṇ+ḍa byā ka ra ṇa'i 'grel chen dang*/ 'chi med mdzod 'grel rgyas pa 'dod 'jo gsang 'gyur stsal ba dang*/ ka lā pa'i byings mdo rtsa 'grel rnams kyang stsal ba'i bka' drin zla bral du che ba byung*/ bka' 'bum 'grel pa de dag khungs btsun yid ches dag gsal ngo mtshar sar pa'i gzugs brgya bkra ba'i bstan bcos kyi me long chen por mngon/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcur bkra shis ltem nas sa dbang bsod nams mgon po yab sras dgon chen 'dir byon pa la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ 'byung 'dul/ ri khrod ma rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ gzhan yang gnyer po rgyal la tshe dbang dang*/ bsod nams sku mched sogs la rjes su gnang ba 'dod chos dgos pa rnams kyi re ba bskangs nas bsnyen mtshams kyi bcad rgyar zhugs/ de'i nyer dgur rang gis tshogs bsags ched du gtsug lag khang du stong chog btsugs/ 'di skabs nas rang gzhan la byad ltas dang rgyal ltas kyi rmi lam mang du byung bas zhag gi phung po snga phyi bzhi lnga tsam gyi dus bzhi rnams su bstan srung dbang po rnams la gtor bsngo brgya rtsa dang 'phrin las bskul ba rnams bgyis pas snga phyir phrin las bsgrub pa'i rtags dngos sam rmi lam du 'ga' zhig byung*/ nub gcig rmi lam du yi ge khur mkhan su yin ma nges par nga rang la yi ge zhig gtad byung ba bltas pas tha shang lab bgin zer ba zhig 'dug

de min 'don rgyu ma byung bar gnyid sad byung ba/ sngon dus 'gro mgon 'phags pas rgya nag tu bzhugs skabs tha shang lab bgin zhes bya ba'i chos log smra ba 'ga' zhig byung ba/ de 'phags pa rin po ches lung rigs kyi sgo nas sun 'byin mdzad rgyu de'i skye ba can zhig gis gnod 'tshe skyel pa'i ltas yin nam snyam/ lcags 'brug hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu bdun la sa skyong lcam dral nas mkhan chen dpal chos pa'i zhal chems kyi bkod pa ltar/ 'byung 'gyur ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa byams chen gyi sku dngos mtho bcu gsum pa gser zangs las bskrun rgyu'i phyi mo thog mar cha tshad dang mthun pa'i lder bzo'i sku zhig bzhengs pa phyi mor bgyis nas/ de la tshad blangs nas bzo ba'i dgongs pas/ lder bzo'i sku la ru shing dang gzungs 'bul nang rten rnams bzhag nas/ dbus lha don grub can sogs dpon g.yog rnams la bzor bcug nged kyi nye bar gnas pa lhun grub phun tshogs can ldan shod du dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhal thang nged kyi bkod pa de la par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pas bka' 'gyur par ma zhig gnang nas bslus pa de gdan 'dren du 'gro ba'i de nyin 'di ga nas nas la gsang sngags zab mo bzlas nas bskur te/ 'di la rgyar nged kyi yang mes rnams kyi dus nas bris pa'i lha la rab gnas ma byas kyang ye shes pa bzhugs pa'i rtags re mi 'byung ba mi srid ces gleng ba ltar/ 'khri shing gi thang kha la'ang nga rang gi rab gnas byas pa yin pas rjes 'brang gzhan yod pa mi srid mod kyi/ shod pa'i dkor bdag cung zad rtsub pas rjes 'khri 'dra 'byung las che bas/ shod pa tshang nas mar 'ong ba'i nub mo'i 'dug zhag gang du phog kyang*/ nas 'di gtor la bgegs bskrad cig gyis shig zhes bslab pa khos kyang de ltar byas nas/ tshes nyer drug chu dron du slebs pa'i nub nor gling tshang gi dge slong kun dga' rab rgyas zhes pa dang mnyam du gnas tshe/

zhal thang bzhugs pa'i sgam bu la zla ba'i 'od kyis khyab 'dug pa mngon sum mthong nas langs te rab rgyas la nam langs 'dug pas 'gro ran byas pas/ nam langs ci yod nam gung yin pa dang*/ zla ba shar don ci yod nyi shu drug bdun gyi nam gung yin zer/ phyi rol du song nas nang du slebs bar zla ba shar ba de'ang mi snang bar gyur to// slar nga la ji ltar gsungs pa de ltar byas pas rtags kyang de lta bu byung bas mkhyen pa dngos su gda' zhes zer gyin mchis/ phyi 'brang gis nyer 'tshe dang bral bar gyur na/ rten gsum gang du bzhugs kyang dge lam 'byung ba byin rlabs kyi mthu yin pa'i phyir smras so// 'khri shing 'dir nyer dgur sleb pa'i nub mor/ dge slong sangs rgyas yon tan gyi rmi lam du/ nged rang gtsug lag khang gi sgo'i rdo cal kha'i skas kyi mgor kha shar phyogs su bltas te khrom tshogs grangs med pa'i dbus su bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka bdun yod pa zhig brjod pa'i snang ba byung ba/ phyi nyin nged rang sar thang kha bshams pa dang der slebs nas thang kha rnams mjal byung ba de'i ltas su mngon zhes ngo mtshar du byed kyin mchis te/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mjal ba'i byin rlabs kyi rten 'brel du dge ba'i ltas su khums/ tshes bcu bdun la yid lhung dpon a dkar 'das pa'i cho ga byed par 'gro dgos pa sde dge'i mdun nas bka' stsal ba ltar der phyin pa'i lam du/ chos rje rab brtan bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa nas 'bod pa'i bang chen gyis 'byor bas der song*/ bla ma la gser chos lugs kyi 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bsgom lung 'bogs pa bcas phul nas dpon tshang gi dub yid lhung thang du mchis pa der bsdad/ kun rig gi byang chog dbang bskur rnams zhag bdun bar byas/ de skabs bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa'ang snyung gzhi lji tsam byung 'dug par thog mar tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster brgya rtsa dang*/

de nas rim gyi 'byung po 'dul byed me dbang can dang*/ gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang*/ 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha/ gser chos khyung nag gza' yum gtso 'khor/ 'od zer can/ seng ge sgra/ khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba rnams kyi rjes gnang*/ spen gtor mar grags pa'i byad 'grol bcas dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang*/ bsrung bzlog khyad par can rnams kyi lung*/ 'jam dpal khro chu dug gdong gi dbang lung bcas rnams phul bas snyung gzhi yar bder gyur/ jo mo klu skyid sogs nang 'khor thams cad la spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gsum pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi rjes gnang byas/ 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshar lnga blugs/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros pa dang*/ bdag jis sangs rgyas dpal 'byor/ smar khams tshul khrims 'od gsal la sogs pa'i bla ma dge slong der bzhugs pa bcu gsum tsam la mgon po khro bcu dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ nyan skor khor yug rnams nas lhags pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi bsngo rten/ skra 'dzin sdom 'bogs/ smon lam dgos pa rnams kyi re ba bskang*/ lha skyabs tshang du 'bod par phyin/ nang tshang rnams la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang dang*/ seng gdong dang gshed dmar rjes gnang byas/ a 'dzi bla ma bsod nams blo gros pas 'bod par phyin/ byang chog dang gshin rje gshed dmar rjes gnang phul/ lam du dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho la nā ro mkha' spyod byas nas/ ja ba'i ru nang du phyin/ stag la shi bar kun rig gi phyir bzlog dbang bskur bcas dang*/ ser 'jo dgon pa'i bla ma dge slong bzhugs pa rnams dang bcas la thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang byas/ ja pa'i jo mo dge bsnyen mar bsgrubs nas 'ongs pa'i lam du bsam 'grub tshang la rje btsun seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang byas/

a rig blo bzang bkra shis pa'i ru nang du slebs/ thang stong pa'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub tshar bdun/ 'byung po 'dul byed dang sgrol ma'i rjes gnang dang kun rig gi byang chog dbang bskur bcas bgyis/ lam du dge slong kun dga' rin chen ming sring g.yon du 'dug par khro bo sme brtsegs kyi rjes su gnang ba mtha' rten bcas dang dus 'das rab rgyas par bsngo ba smon lam byas/ slar lha ru dpon tshang du slebs pa der ka thog sprul pa'i sku gdan drang byung ba la mjal dar phul/ phyi nyin 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi nang nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub skor rnams kyi lung dgos gsungs nas sprul pa'i sku 'khor bcas phebs byung bar mjal 'dzom dang gsung gleng lung 'bul lhan cig byung bar/ sprul sku mkhyen rab ches gsal ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen zla bral zhig tu go bas dad gus skye ba byung ngo*// de nas bteg 'ongs par thar rtse chos rje bsod nams grags pa dpon g.yog rnams la khro bo 'cho lab ljang nag gi rjes gnang mtha' rten bcas dang*/ thang sku gsar bskrun rnams la rab gnas mdor bsdus byas/ bdag jis bla gsar sangs rgyas dpal 'byor pa dang skya 'bes tshul khrims bkra shis kyis 'bod par song*/ thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang byas/ bdag jis bla rgan phun tshogs chos 'phel bas ge mdzo mdar bla brang gzims khang gsar du brgyabs pa'i nang du son/ bla ma 'di nyid ni sku tshe'i stod du grwa sar bla ma gong ma'i dus ja mar me sogs kyi dge rgyun tshogs bsag rgya chen bsgrubs pa dang*/ khams su sbyin bdag rnams la'ang chos dang mthun pa'i phan 'dogs phrin las rgyas pa dang*/ sku tshe smad du khang gsar mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po pa dang*/ dpal ldan chos skyong pa rnams nas bka' stsal phebs don ltar yid lhung ge mdzo mdor chos sde 'debs pa'i gzhi 'ding ba bcas/

rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i bstan par sman 'dogs che ba'i smon lam gyi snye ma dus su smin pa'i gang zag mchog cig tu mngon no// der bla ma rnam gnyis sku 'khor du bcas la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dbang dang*/ gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur dang nye bar mkho ba'i lung tshogs 'ga' zhig phul/ de nas bteg pa'i lam du a 'dzi dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyis 'bod par song*/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dbang dang spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang byas/ ba pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'bod par phyin/ phyi nyin ma sogs la kun rig gi dbang dang*/ der 'dus bcas la spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gyi rjes gnang byas/ de dag gi bar skabs rnams su skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang dge bsnyen sdom pa/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs gang dgos rnams kyi re ba bskang*/ ru dam dgon pa'i lung mdar rdzogs chen pa nas bla ma theg mchog pa las ja 'dren gnang sbyin ston mo bcas stsal ba bsnams nas bzhugs pa dang*/ gsung gleng cung zad zhig gi yun du bsdad/ de nas bteg ste rgyab stod blang shing thang du gnyer chen bsod nams bkra shis pa cung zad bro 'tshal stabs kyis ru ba bcas der bzhugs par 'bod du byung bar son/ tshe dpag med la brten pa'i 'chi bslu dang grub thob tshe sgrub brgya tshar bsags/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ seng ge'i gdong can/ mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang byas mthar rdo rje 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sreg blugs tshar lnga blugs pa sogs thugs bzhed bskangs nas lhun grub steng du slebs/ sa gas nya ba'i zla bar mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal chos pa'i sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pa dang*/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros/ bzhi sde bla ma rin chen chos dar/ dgon chen pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad pa sogs kha shas la kho bos bsgrigs pa'i yi ge'i steng nas snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rnams dang*/

rgya gzhung gi lung bcas phul/ nye bar gnas pa lhun grub phun tshogs kyis thang ka'i ras gzhi bzos nas/ 'di'i steng na khyed kyi rtogs brjod tshar cig ri mor 'dri ba'i skya ris nyid nas brgyab pa stsal na/ dgun ka 'dir karma'i lha dga' spun gyis tshon mdangs bcad sogs rdzogs par 'dri bar ched byas pas/ skya ris sol tho brgyab grogs kyi zer ba ltar/ gang dran bris pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi bkod pa da ltar phan gyi byas byung bris pa thang kha lnga byung song*/ thang kha skar 'dzin sang nyin byed rgyu'i nub mor der lhun grub phun tshogs rang gi rmi lam gyi snang bar gtso bo nga rang gi gzugs brnyan de glang po che'i khri'i steng na gnas pa shin tu byon legs pa zhig bris tshar ba'i 'khris der gal ta zung 'brel nas dkar gyis bkang ba'i steng na spos reng brgya chag dang 'bri byed yol pir mang tsam bcas bzhag pa zhig rmis 'dug pa thang kha 'dri rgyu bzhi dang bcas pa gegs med mthar phyin 'byung ba'i rten 'brel zhig yin nam snyam pa byung*/ sku dbon rin chen mchog grub nas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung gnang ba nas/ kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer rdzogs mtshams man chad kyi lung rnams bdag gis kyang thob/ sku dbon pa de nyid la dgon pa'i nas der yod rnams bcas la/ dpal ldan chos skyong gi rnam par thar pa dbu nas brtsams te sku dbon dang phyag mdzod gnyis dbus gtsang du dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i phyir bteg pa tshun chad kyi lung rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ nga rang gis byas pa'i rat+na shās+t+raṃ kyi sde nas kyang ga nga ca a dkar chag shrī can te glegs bam lnga dang cha rtags can gyi glegs bam smad nas bsang mchod kyi skor rnams bcas pa'i lung rnams 'bul ba'i sgang la rdza nas 'ongs pa'i lha rje chos skyong zhes bya bas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi po ti brgya dang dgu rab gnas rgyur gdan drangs byung ba la rab gnas byed rgyu byung ba dang*/

lung grub nas mar tsam 'ongs pa'i lam du wā rā ṇa sī nas 'ongs pa'i a tsa ra gha ne pū ri zhes pa bod skad bsgyur na stug por gang ba zhes sam grong khyer du khyab pa'am gang ba zhes 'gyur ba'i ming can zhig gis lag tu dar dkar po zhig thogs nas bdag la byin byung ba de chos skyong dgyes pa'i rtags shig yin nam snyam pa'i spro ba brtas/ gzhan yang sku dbon de nyid la sman bla'i rjes gnang dang*/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi dbang lung 'ga' re bcas 'bul grub/ nyer dgu la lcags rar dpon srung lu pa 'tsho dus las bskal par 'da' ka ma'i gdams pa gsal 'debs dang kun rig dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phyir bzlog bcas bgyis/ khrums kyi nya ba'i zhag mdzod kyi tshes brgyad nas rgyal rong nas byon pa'i bla ma/ grwa rigs bcu drug tsam la kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi rgyu dbang*/ rab byung bsgrub bya tshan pa lnga rnams bsgrubs/ de nas mi ring bar chu tshan la bteg nas/ der yang ser skya pho mo 'dus pa rnams la yi ge drug pa sogs kyi rjes gnang nyin gsum tsam dang*/ mar lam sga len steng du bla ma dge slong 'ga' la 'jam dpal khro chu sman gdong gi dbang dang khrom mang rnams la'ang rjes gnang dang bsngo ba/ skyabs sdom 'bogs dgos sogs kyis re ba bskang*/ slar lhun grub steng du kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen pa 'ga' zhig la rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang byas/ dbang gi sta gon tshugs pa na dge slong zhig gis bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi 'dul ba po ti dang po de rab gnas bya rgyur spyan drangs pa rten 'brel legs snyam pa shar/ 'dzom thog tu tshang dpon mgon po srung sdum bar du dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan can sku tshe'i dus 'das par 'bod du byung bar song*/ der kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur phyir/ bzlog byang sreg dang khyim tshang 'khor bcas rjes su gnang ba kha shas dang*/

mgon po chos bzang pas bsti gnas su 'bod par phyin/ der skyed byed ma la sogs pa'i khyim tshang du gang yod bcas la kun rig gi dbang dang*/ tshe sgrub kyi dbang dang rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos rnams kyis re ba bskang*/ tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin phan gling bla brang nas mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i sku gdung ril por bzhugs yul tsan+dan gyi za ma tog gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dga'i gtsang khang du spyan 'dren zhus pas/ nam mkhar 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar ba sogs ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas byung ngo*// 'dir smras pa/ sngon bsags legs byas mdog bzang sgo nga yi// snying po chos ldan mi bdag 'jig rten mes// sde bzhi'i dpal gyis gdong mdzes thor tsugs rtser// las bzang gis byin rigs bdag nor bu'i tog /bslu med gtan gyi skyabs mchog gsang ba gsum// bsam kyin yi ge'i bzlas brjod tsam zhig las// 'dren byed yul du mngon sum bgyid pa las// yul dus rnam pas bskal gyur gang gi tshe// myur 'gro bdun ldan theg pa'i skal ba brten// gzi brgya 'bar ba'i dge mtshan lham me bas// 'dab stong gzhon nu'i tshal gyi phan bde'i dpal// ge sar grangs med 'dzum bsu'i gar gyis spyon// skye bar sbyangs stobs mi dman snying rje'i gdong*// byang chub sems kyis lan brgyar phyis snyam byed// 'dzum zer dkar pos khor yug mun pa yang*// nges par bkru bzhin lha de'i skal bas thob// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i skyabs// rtag tu yid byed chab 'bangs kyis mtshon pa'i// 'gro 'dis ched du ma gnyer shākya'i sras// gnyis pa thob pa'i dga' bde brjod mi ldangs// zhes pa ltar ste/ de'ang ji ltar na/ shrī e waṃ chos ldan chos grwa chen po zhes yongs su grags pa gang yin pa nas/ bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum chos kyi sgo mangs 'byed pa'i khri thogs kyi las 'dzin gyi mdzad pa thar phyin nas klu sdings bla brang du zur bzhugs mdzad par/

sa'i steng na mtshungs zlas dben pa'i bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor lo sngon du 'gro bas/ yangs pa'i gser ldan gyi dkyil 'khor du 'khod dgu'i lus can mtha' dag dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dge ba bcu dang rjes su mthun pa'i bka' khrims kyis bkod pas 'gro ba ma lus bde bar skyong ba'i sa skyong bla ma rgyal ba'i myu gu pa chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa grwa sar phebs pa'i dus nas tshigs gsum rim nos kyi sgo nas so thar sdom pa dang*/ byang sems sdom pa dang*/ sngags kyi sdom pa ste gsum char thob yul dka' drin zla med kyi skyabs yul gcig pu yin pa bzhin/ deng yang de nyid bla'i mchod gnas su spyan 'dren pa btang nas/ gzhung sa chen por rgyal tshab de mo sprul pa'i sku dang*/ gdan sa gong du lhar bcas skye dgu'i skyabs mgon chen po bcas pa/ dgongs pa zhus pa bzhin du/ de dag nas kyang dgongs 'grol byung ba ltar/ spyan drangs nas byon pa/ 'di gar rab byung 'dod pa'i lcags 'brug gi gnam lo'i rgyu skar sman drug gi nya yongs su gang ba'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la lha'i bla ma rgyal sar phebs pa'i nyin/ legs par gsungs pa chos 'dul mtsho'i bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin cing legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug 'phags pa dgra bcom pa chen po/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod gzhung pa ma lus pa 'dzin cing*/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rol pas 'gro ba rgya mtsho bu gcig pu ltar brtse ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems chen/ gsung rab kun gyi yang rtse gsang chen rdo rje'i theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin cing*/ skal bar ldan pa'i lus can mtha' dag sku bzhi zung 'jug gi rgyu thabs 'bras bu ci rigs par smin par byed pa'i rigs mchog rdo rje 'chang ba chen po/ thun mong 'gro ba'i snang ngor mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po shar chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa gang de/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po chab 'bangs su bcas pas nye bar mtshon pa'i bstan 'gro spyi'i skyabs mgon mchog tu gegs bral legs par thob bo// de nyin don gnyer zhig gi ngor/ rang la bstod pa zhig kyang sug bris byas/ 'di skabs rang gzhan gyi ngor/ mkhan por khri 'bul gyi 'bul tho 'ga' re bris/ de nas hor zla bcu pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la/ gtsug lag khang mthong na mngon par dga' bar/ bkod legs mi 'gyur gser gyi khri chen por spyan drangs te/ ngo mtshar dga' ston legs mtshon khri 'bul sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po gtsor bzhugs pa'i sku 'khor yongs rdzogs dang*/ mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i dgon sde/ rdzogs bzhugs bcas mi sna 'dzom pa kun dang lhan cig mdun 'jog stob pa'i thog mar/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul bas thog drangs te/ khri 'bul rnams rim par bstar nas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa 'phral du dgos pa byung bar/ kho bor bka' stsal phebs pa ltar ji ltar rigs pa'i spros bshad kyi sngun bsu ba'i/ 'dus tshogs thams cad kyis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun pa bcas phul/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ bkra shis brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i lung kha shas shis par gyur pa'i rten 'brel du stsal ba rnams legs par nos so// zhag shas song ba na mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal snga nas bka' stsal phebs pa yar bzlog ma spobs par sgrol ma dkar mo/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul ba/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs/ seng gdong sngon mo rnams kyi rjes gnang rnams phul/ mkhan chen dpal chos pa'i sku gdung mchod rten gyi nang du 'jug rgyu'i 'khor lo rnams sgrub pa'i nyer bsdogs su bsnyen sgrub byed pa rnams la dzam+bha la 'brug zhon dang*/ dzam dmar gyi rjes gnang lung bcas dang*/

mgon dkar dang*/ dbyug gu mched gsum sgrub skor gyi lung rnams phul/ tshes bcu bzhi nas bsnyen sgrub pa rnams kyi sgrub rten du ku ru kul+le'i don kun grub pa'i 'khor lo ril bu sgrub pa la/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du khrol bur bsgrub pa/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor du dib mar sgrub pa/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor du ril bu sgrub pa rnams dang*/ nus ldan gyi 'khor lo dang*/ liṅga'i 'khor lo/ lha mi dbang du byed pa rnams kyang rab tu gnas pa rdzas dang bcas pa phal cher 'dzom pa'i khul gyis bris pas sgrub pa rnams kyi bca' bsgrigs dang*/ dzam+bha la dkar po ga'u la brten te sgrub pa/ dzam dmar dang mgon dkar gyi 'khor lo dang bum pa sgrub pa/ dbyug gu spun gsum gyi tsakra/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sgrub rten bca' ba 'dri bkod tshar nas so sor sgrub tu bcug pa/ gzhan yang 'phral du sgrub rgyur ma 'grigs kyang*/ tshogs bdag gi 'khor lo dang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo tha chen bcas pa'ang rab tu gnas pa byas pa bcas bris/ de rnams grub nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor las/ gzhan dbang du bya ba bu mo'i 'khrul 'khor/ nor rgyas par byed pa gnod sbyin gyi 'khrul 'khor/ stobs rgyas par byed pa glang po che'i 'khrul 'khor/ tshe rgyas par byed pa bum pa'i 'khrul 'khor sogs 'dri ba rnams ni sngags btu ba drangs pa spo ba/ bsre ba rnams kyis 'khor lo 'dri sgrub pa lhan cig byed dgos mchis pa rnams kho bos bgyis/ de ltar bsnyen sgrub la zhugs pa rnams grangs them nas/ lcags sbrul gyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shur gser gdung khri khar mnga' gsol te/ nang rten gyi 'khor lo bum gter rnams 'jog pa nas brtsams pa'i/ chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs 'bul dang*/ sku gdung gi za ma tog bcas bzhugs su gsol te/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos mtshon pa'i dad ldan rnams nas snyan dar gyi rigs rnams gsol ba dang*/ kho bos kyang mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam zhes pa'i mtshan gsol dang*/ 'dod don gsol gdab lhan cig pa'i snyan dar phul/ slar yang mi ring bar mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa tshogs kyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i sa skya'i sman pa bla ma dang phur sgrub bla ma/ ngor pa'i chos rje rnams dang*/ dgon chen du bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams dang bcas bsnyen song brgya phrag gcig gis rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa nyin gsum pa zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ rab gnas bzang drug gi bshad pa byed srol mchis par kho bos cung zad spros pa'i bshad pa rgyas pa zhig byas/ de'i rjes su bkra shis bshad pa dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pas mdzad song*/ rmor tsha sprul sku rig 'dzin chos dbang pas/ nged rang sar byon te/ khong gi sngar rmi lam du mi cig gis sang nyin mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa'i dpe cha zhig khyed la 'bul bar 'gyur bas khyed kyang gsungs na yag po yod zer ba la/ khong gi 'on kyang lung ni thob mi thub bam byas pas/ lung yang dpe cha khur mkhan de la yod zer ba zhig byung*/ phyi nyin sde dge'i sku tshab a zlos kyi/ khyed kyis mdzad pa'i tshem bu lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs nyung ngu don tshang zhes bya ba de nga la bstan byung ba dang de'i lung yang zhus pa yin pas khyed nyid mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos rnam 'phrul zhig yin nges 'dug pas/ nga rang mjal du 'ong ba yin zhes gsung zhing nyams bzhes kyi rtogs 'bul zhig kyang mdzad byung*/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i lung dgos gsungs pa ltar phul/ slar khong la zhal gdams zhig kyang gnang dgos zhes gsungs pa'i ngor/ zab mo don las brtsams pa'i gdams pa thar mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba zhig bris nas phul/

de dang mthun par bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gang zag sgos kyi lung bstan rat+na'i sgrom bu las/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa ni/ 'bri zhes rat+na'i ming can 'byung*// bla med rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i 'khor lo bskor// zhes dang*/ yang nub gcig rmi lam tu sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa nyan thos kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba mjal ba dang*/ nga rang gi 'gram du khrag bo ba gzhan 'ga' byi dor byed pa dang*/ de rjes nas gcig gis ral gri rwa sngon gyi yu bar byas pa zhig gtad byung ba'i snang ba shar te sems 'khrul pa'i 'di rigs la bden pa ci yod bsams nas btang snyoms su bzhag kyang*/ phyi nyin ja 'dren mkhan gyis phor par ja zhig blugs song bar/ ja zhag rul ba dang bri ngan bro ba zhig byung nas ma btung bar/ dor zhog ces smras par bkra shis nor bu dang lhun grub phun tshogs gnyis kyi cung zad re btung song yang*/ de ma thag nas zhe mer te cung zad re skyug song yang*/ de phyin khong gnyis ka zhag shas skyugs mer ba dang na ba zhig byung song bar dug sngags mang du bzlar bcug pas bkra shis nor bu ma gnod kyang*/ lhun grub phun tshogs ni/ de nas bzung ste yun ring du mi bde ba zhig byung ste/ mthar rin chen ril bu zhig btung bas je bder song*/ phyis su khong tsho na pa dang sngar gyi rmi lam la gzhigs pas nga rang gi btung rgyu ma byung ba de dkon mchog thugs rjes bsrungs par khums so// hor zla gsum pa'i nyer bdun bkra shis ltem du sa skyong bsod nams mgon po sku 'tsho'i dus las 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub du song bar zhag bcu bzhir kun rig gi cho ga phyir zlog dbang sbyin bsreg bcas bgyis/ lha sras rin po che chos skyong mgon sku 'khor du bcas pa la tshe sgrub kyi dbang dang*/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ phyag na rdo rje rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ dbon stod pa dang sna 'brang ba'i dge slong der bzhugs rnams la mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang dang*/

dbu mdzad sogs kyi ngor/ sāts+tsha sgrub tshul dang*/ gur mgon gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ gsang sgrub dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i go mtshon sogs bris/ de mtshams tshur bteg nas dbon 'das po nyid nas dpal chos pa'i sku brnyan bzheng bar zhal gyis 'ches pa dang*/ dpal sa skya sku zhabs rtse nas bsrung ba lnga'i lha mo rnams kyi gser sku bzo rgyur stsal ba'i blugs dpe'i kha bkod dang*/ mkhan chen klu sdings pas lha ris pa lha dga' spun la 'dod lha'i zhal thang 'ga' zhig 'dri ba sogs kyi kha ta bgyis pa mthar phyin/ dgun po na yul du phyin te mtshams byas par chos 'khor lcags ra ngag dbang sprul sku'i zhal snga nas/ sngar nas khyod las brda sprod pa'i ri mo zhig slob 'dun shin tu che bar byung ba/ de lta na'ang de bzhin stabs 'grigs ma byung*/ da lam khyed 'dir byon pa dang stabs 'grigs shin tu legs pa zhig byung bas/ dgun ka 'dir chos 'khor du 'ong thub pa zhig cis kyang bka' drin che dgos tshul phebs par/ gyi na pas bsnyen pa zhig bsags bsams kyang*/ sprul pa'i sku nyid bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu khyad 'phags su bzhugs par gor ma chag pa dang*/ khyad par deng dus rig gnas la thugs stsol bskyed pa ni mkhas par 'os pa'i bya ba yang dag par go bas/ de ltar gzigs thub pa zhig byung na/ rang gi 'bad stsol byas pa'ang don yod du 'gro ba'i sman yod mchis pas/ ji ltar stsol ba de ltar zhabs 'degs zhu zhes gsol/ gza' skar dge ba'i dus 'dzom dang bcas te chos 'khor du phyin/ zhwa ser bstan pa'i snang byed chen po mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag lcags ra sprul pa'i sku rin po che ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang la/ sgra ka lā pa'i ri mo yongs rdzogs dang sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi ri mo bcas phul ba lag len gnad du khel ba tshegs med du mkhyen pa'i brda sprod kun bshad kyi mtshan du ngag dbang gzhon nu'i sgyu 'phrul rnam par rtsen pa dbyangs ldan gdong drug dgyes pa'i smra mkhas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol/

rigs byed ma la sogs kyi dbang lung kha shas kyang phul/ kho bor legs sor lo paṇa gyi dbu zhwa gtsos brgya 'bul gyi ster cha gnang*/ slar sa dkar du phyin nas bsang sogs gsar rtsom kha shas dang dbang lung dgos rigs bcas don gnyer rnams kyi re bskang grub nas chos grwa 'dir 'ong*/ mkhan rin po che'i bka' bzhin ldan skye sku rab 'byams dkon mchog phun tshogs zer ba la sgra snyan ngag gnyis ka bslab khrid bgyis/ zhe chen drung yig bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan can sngar nas rtsis skor sogs la sbyangs pa byas 'dug par sde dge'i mdun nas ngos sar bcar ste rig gnas skor bslab dgos tshul gsungs pa/ sgra ka lā pa'i ri mo yongs rdzogs go don 'phrod pa/ snyan ngag rtsom rgyug yongs rdzogs/ sdeb sbyor bṛt+ta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi sa bcad drug mthar phyin/ lan war sogs bslab khrid rgyas pas khong rang rig pa bzang zhing brtson 'grus che ba bcas kyis shin tu byang po byung song*/ phyis su dpal ldan sa skyar yang slob grwa 'dzugs thub pa dang*/ ngor mkhan chen yas mar gyi gsan yig bsgrigs thub pa bcas bslab pa go chod nges su snang bas rjes su yi rang*/ gzhan yang bar skabs rnams su mkhar dbon chos skyong bsam 'grub/ mgon bla kun dga' bsod nams/ thang sgom bla ma grags ldan/ gzi'i rin chen chos 'phel sogs la snyan ngag yongs rdzogs kyi bslab khrid byas/ phur pa bla mas zhus ngor gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma dang*/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor brtsams/ slar yang dgun po der sa dkar du phyin par chos sde dpon kun dga' blo gros nad bab lji ba zhig gis zin 'dug pa dbang rjes gnang sogs byas kyang*/ drag tu mi 'dug pas khong rang nas 'tsho thub min byung na rje shul gyi bya ba 'di ltar dgos tshul zer ba/ nged nas dbang gi rigs dang brtag par ci bab kyi rim gro rnams bsgrubs kyang bzlog tu ma rnyed par tshe'i 'phen pa btang song bas/

rjes nas sde dge'i drung nas kyang sku tshab btang ste a dran bu'i shul gyi byed lugs skor la khyod nas lta rtogs zhib pa dgos tshul phebs pas/ nged nas sa skya gang phyin gyi 'gro rten dgos rigs sogs dge rdzongs gi rigs rnams dang*/ gzhan ma'i gnas lugs skor gyi bkod pa zhib rgyas bgyis te bral ba chod mtshams sa dkar du phyin/ lab bla ma mdo rgyud rgya mtshor grags pa mkhas pa du ma bsten cing rgyud lung man ngag du ma la nang byan chud pa/ khyad par rtsis skor la brgyud thag nye ba khungs btsun pa dpyod ldan mgu ba bskyed pa'i mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa las/ bai dkar ma bu'i thog nas dus rtsis mtha' dag dang*/ nag rtsis bcas man ngag gab sbas mtha' dag dang*/ dbyangs 'char rgyud gzhung rtsa ba dang mkhas pa bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i tsakra nyis bsgrags kyi lag khrid zhib rgyas dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i yig cha'i thog nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor yongs rdzogs sogs gnad 'gag che sar brjed byang zin bris bcas ma lus par bslab sbyang bgyis pa'i rtsis skor gyi brgyud pa sngar thob yig par du grub par ma 'khod pas 'dir smos pa'i thog mar lnga bsdus dang sgra gcan rtsis skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ phug pa chos rje dpal mgon phan las yan sngar bkod kyi thob yig nang bzhin la/ de nas/ bde legs gar dbang phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin chen po gzhon nu don grub/ zur kun mkhyen chen po chos dbyings rang grol/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ de las 'jam dbyangs mi rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho

'di gnyis phar slob tshur slob yin 'dug dang*/ lu mgo bla mkhyen ngag dbang mkhyen brtse pa gnyis kas zhus/ phyi ma las 'bos stod pa dbang rgyal rdo rje/ de las zhabs drung mkhas dbang bde 'byung rnam par rol pa'am/ mdo rgyud rgya mtshor grags pa'i zhabs drung nas bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob pa'o// ༈ /phug lugs re mig rgya mtsho/ li tho nang ma bzo tshul sogs phug lugs che phra rnams kyi brgyud pa/ lugs gcig la ldum po don dbang yan thob yig nang ltar dang*/ de nas kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po man gong bzhin dang*/ ༈ yang lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan mkhas grub nor bzang pa'i gza' lnga nyin zhag sogs kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ chos rje dpal mgon phrin las nas/ mkhas grub dpal kyi seng ge sngags 'chang g.yu lo pa/ gnyags ban nang ra ba bla mkhyen ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po man 'dra/ ༈ gza' lnga chos spyod la brten pa'i re mig rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal mgon phrin las nas/ chos rje 'chi med bde ba/ mkhas pa rdo rje'i mtshan can/ dus 'khor rab 'byams pa/ smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/ de sras mkhas dbang 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ kun mkhyen lnga pa man 'dra/ ༈ dpal dbyangs 'char gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho yan thob yig nang bzhin dang*/ de man chad gong dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na/ dpal mgon phrin las nas/ chos rje 'chi med bde ba sogs gong tshes spyod re mig ltar bgrang yang rung ngo*// ༈ /legs bshad bai ḍūr+ya dkar po las ji ltar byung ba'i nag rtsis rdel 'grems yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs las/ lha chen tshangs pa gdong bzhi/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ lha mo rnam rgyal ma/ bram ze ser skya ste zhu ba po bzhi/ kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ ji kong 'phrul gyi rgyal po/

ji nang 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ wang the 'phrul gyi rgyal po ste 'phrul gyi mi bzhi/ drang srong bde bar len pa/ drang srong nye bar len pa/ kun tu len pa/ yang dag par len pa ste len pa mi bzhi/ drang srong phur bu/ lce mur/ mur ti/ thor cog ste 'chang ba mi bzhi/ slob dpon du har nag po/ ā tsar dmar po/ paṇa chen zla ba nag po/ mkhas pa mi bzhi/ khams pa phra mo/ 'phan yul ra la bhe ra badz+ra/ mal ze glan/ se ston khri/ se ston rgyang yod/ rgya ston/ zhang*/ khyung nag shākya dar rgyas/ phug pa me nyag rgyal mtshan/ sngags pa lhun grub dpa' bo/ bla ma mkhas grub pa/ mkhas pa ār+ya de ba/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas blo gros/ phug pa dpal mgon phrin las/ bde legs gar dbang man chad gong lnga bsdus dang sgra gcan rtsis skor gyi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na/ dpal mgon phrin las nas/ mkhas mchog dpal gyi seng ge sngags 'chang g.yu lo pa man gong nor bzang rgya mtsho'i gza' lnga nyin zhag gi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na/ ār+ya de ba nas/ dus rams pa don grub kun dga' dge bsnyen bsod nams tshe 'dzin/ slob dpon bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje phun tshogs dge dbang*/ mkhas grub dpal gyi seng ge mkhas dbang bkra shis/ ldum po don grub dbang rgyal/ 'dar pa lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ lu mgo bla mkhyen ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ 'jam dbyangs mi rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ snga ma las 'bos stod dbang rgyal rdo rje/ rtsis rig smra ba'i nyi ma bde 'byung rnam par rol ba'i zhabs/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lag len mdzub khrid mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas bstsal ba yin no// ༈ /'jigs byed 'khrul 'khor gyi brgyud pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ lce ston chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/ mkhas mchog zla ba dpal rin/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/

byang gling pa rin can rgyal po/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/ chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po/ khri don grub rgya mtsho/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ gangs ri nam mkha' bzang po/ rgyud smad grub mkhan po dpal 'byor grags pa/ des rong po sngags rams pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ de las mkhas btsun bla ma bde 'byung rnam par rol pa/ de la bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lung dang lag len phra zhib du stsal ba'o// bla ma rang la yang dpal mgon zhal gyi rjes gnang dang gsang khrid yongs rdzogs zhib rgyas phul/ shar chen mkhan rin po che chos sde rdzongs du spyan 'dren zhus byung bas sa dkar du rang gi gnas khang du gdan 'dren zhus nas zhag gcig bzhugs te tshe dbang sogs bka' drin stsal nas phyi nyin byon song*/ gzhan yang don gnyer 'ga'i ngor rang gi brtsams chos skor gyi lung bklag le thang chos rje dpon g.yog kha shas ched gtad kyis ngos 'phrad la byon par spyan ras gzigs kyi dmar khrid rgyas pa dang gzhan yang dbang lung kha shas phul/ sa dkar 'dus sde byings nas tshe dpag med la brten pa'i kho bo ring 'tsho'i cho ga bsgrubs/ de skor brel pa chod nas slar yang lhun grub steng du 'ong*/ gtor ma la spu nag skye ba cung zad skyon du 'dzin mkhan kyang yod 'dug kyang*/ 'di lor rgyun gyi thugs dam gtor ma la spu 'jag dkar nag skye ba sogs byung ba legs nyes kyi mtshan ma ma nges/ de skabs shig tu yid lhung dpon gyi sku mched bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'das sar 'gro dgos par sa dbang sde dge'i bka' bzhin bteg nas byang chog bsngo smon sogs dang*/ zhal bzhugs rnams la dbang rjes gnang sogs gang dgos phul/ zla se 'gyo dgon du phyin nas kye rdor rgyu dbang sogs bgyis/

khro tshang pho brang du rdzong dpon mgon po sogs la rjes gnang kha shas dang*/ 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa sogs kyis re ba bskangs/ tshur lam bdag jis chos rje dkon mchog phun tshogs dpon slob rnams la spyan ras gzigs dmar khrid dang rjes gnang sogs phul/ gzhan yang don gnyer dad ldan rnams kyi ngor dbang rjes gnang khrid lung ci 'grub bgyis nas tshur 'khor/ gnyer chen bsod nams bkra shis 'das sar pos par byang chog bsngo smon rgyas 'debs dang rjes bzhugs rnams la dbang sogs phul nas sa dbang chen po'i mdun 'khor gto ru sangs rgyas seng ge'i ngor phyin nas pha rgan rgis lu sogs la kun rig dbang brgya dang*/ phyis su yang pha rgan de dus las yol ba'i dgung zhag nang du slebs pas byang chog sogs bgyis/ shar pa mkhan chen drung nas kye rdor rgyu dbang*/ lam dbang*/ 'jigs byed rgyu dbang*/ kun rig dbang*/ rnam rgyal ma/ tshe dbang lcags sdong ma sogs dang*/ skyes rabs mdzad chen/ chos chung skor/ sku zhabs rang gi gsung brtsams skor gyi lung rnams thos/ skyabs mgon de nyid la sam+bu ṭa'i rgyu dbang*/ bcu gcig zhal gyi rgyu dbang*/ kun rig tshe dpag lha dgu/ 'chi 'joms/ khros nag rnams kyi dbang*/ tshe dbang brgya tshar/ snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang rgya gzhung gi lung bcas dang khro bcu dang mgon po sprin gseb ma'i rjes gnang bcas phul/ tshe dpag med la brten pa'i sku tshe brten bzhugs kyi cho ga sgrub pa dang gsol 'debs bcas bgyis/ drung yig shākya chos 'phel can la gshang yig che chung lañca wa tu bcas kyi snyug 'gros rnams zhib pa dang*/ lha'i ri mo thig tshad bcas sngar nas rang gi lag khrid bgyis zin pa dang*/ 'di skabs snyan ngag yongs rdzogs bslab/ rang gi nyer gnas lhun grub phun tshogs la yi ge'i snyug 'gros dang*/ sgra ka lā pa'i ri mo yongs rdzogs/ sdeb sbyor gyi ri mo bcas dang*/

snyan ngag yongs rdzogs/ rtsis skor bcas zhib bslab bgyis/ sog yul nas byon pa'i a li chos rje kun dga' bsod nams ces par dbang lung skor tshan che ba bgyis/ sa dkar du kho bo'i sha nye mkha' 'gro skyabs chu gzhi'i nad bab lji ba zhig gi zin pa'i gnas tshul bang mi 'byor bas/ nga rang 'gro chog pa sa skyong chen po'i mdun la dgongs zhus byas kyang 'dzom thog pho brang du lcam bkra shis dbang mo sku lus sbrum pa'i rim gro par 'gro dgos tshul gyis dgongs pa ma khrol bar bka' lung gyen bzlog ma spobs pas sa dkar du gcen gyi rtsar grwa pa btang*/ dngos phrad ma byung ba de tshab tu kaḥthog dang dpal yul dgon la ma ṇi dung phyur re 'don rten dngos rdzas yi ge bcas bskur/ kho bo 'dzom thog pho brang du bteg der sku zhabs si tu pa'ang phebs byung bas zhal mjal zhus par zhag shas nas phebs song*/ nged rang mgon po brag rdzong gi bsnyen mtshams la zhugs nas thun skabs su lcam la dbang bka' phul/ sa dbang drung nas lcam gyi sku phyar brtag pa dgos tshul phebs par mchog gsum dpang 'dzugs kyi gsol btab bgyis pas shin tu 'tshubs cha che ba zhig las ma shar bas rkyen bzlog rim gro tshan che ba bsgrubs song*/ de skabs nged kyi sha nye rgas po snga lam du bteg tshar ba'i bya ma rta 'byor pas rang ngos nas smon lam byang chog sogs gang dgos bgyis/ lhun grub steng du stong chog lag 'dzugs dang*/ sa skya gong du gser zho lnga bcu mdzod gos gtsos pa'i bsngo rten phul/ gzhan ma 'di gar shar chen sku zhabs mkhan rin po che dang*/ si tu sprul pa'i sku'i gtsos mchod yul kun la bsngo 'brel sogs rjes kyi bsags sbyong ci 'grub bgyis/ de mtshams zhig nas nged kyi mig g.yas par sngon nas skyon byung ba'i gsal po med thog 'di skabs yon mchod gnyis ka'i rkyen gegs lta bus g.yon pa'ang 'grib song*/

de skabs rmi lam du khang pa zhig gi nang du mtsho chen 'khyil bar mtsho zur de nas nga rang rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas bsdad 'dug pa'i mtsho nang de nas dkar yol gyi bum pa khur mkhan zhig byung ba/ 'di blang na klu'i gter gyi bum pa zhig yin las che bsams nas skyil krung ma zhig par mtsho dbus su song bas khru gang tsam nas zin yang*/ dang po dkar yol 'dra ba la de rjes sa bum 'dra ba zhig tu song*/ de yang lag pa g.yon na cung zhig bzhag pas zog gi 'gram rus 'dra ba zhig tu song pa rmis pas rigs kyi khye'u mtshan 'gyur ltas e yin snyam nas phyi nyin brtag bsgril bgyis par de mtshungs shar bas/ sku tshab gzungs srung la rigs sras khyad 'phags zhig sbrum 'dug par nges kyang 'gyur ltas yin nam ci yin ma nges pas rim gro dgos tshul sogs sa skyong chen por gting bskul zhu bcug pas/ sku zhabs rnam gnyis kyi brtag lung sogs la ci bab sku rims bsgrubs song*/ nga rang nas kyang bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams la sa skyong rigs kyi khye'u mi 'gyur ba dang*/ sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba brtsams te/ sa byi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la lhun grub steng gi mgon khang yas mar la 'bul rgyu zhur btang*/ yang lan gcig dpal sa skya pa chen po sku shin tu mdangs gsal khri bkod legs kyis steng du bzhugs pa mjal bar sngon med kyi dad dga' gsar 'phel rmis/ zla ba 'di'i tshes bcu dgu nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor yod nyin nas yar tshes rgyal ba dang po'i nyin bar sa g.yos mang du byung song bas sa skyong rigs kyi myu gu 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i dge mtshan zhig tu mngon/ lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum nub mor rmi lam du rgya mtsho'i 'gram kun dga' rwa ba lta bur rang gnas par chos skyong gur zhal 'khor bcas rnams phal pa'i gzugs kyis byung bar de nang nas zhal gyi sprul pa mi skra dkar can gyi gleng brjod shin tu mang po'i skad cha byed 'dug tshe/

kho bo nas da lta de thams cad kyis gyod thag bcad nas gcod rgya gnang tshar ram zhes smras pa dang lan ma byung bar gnyid sad pas phrin las bcol don grub pa'i ngo 'dra ba snyam/ phyi nub ri mgo thams cad nyi ma gser gyi mdog can shar 'dug pa rmis pas/ phyi nyin tshes lnga nyin 'phral du dpal mgon zhal bzhi par phrin bcol lha dbang rdo rje zhes bya ba snyan shal du bris nas bskang so stong tshar bsags pa dang chabs cig phul bas/ de nub nas mi ring bar lha sras dam pa 'di nyid yum gyi sku la gnod pa med pa bde bar btsas so// de rjes nas lcam nyid snyun bab ji ljir song nas sku zhabs si tu rin po che nas dbang bka' sman bcos sogs ci 'grub dang*/ nged rang nas kyang rjes gnang sogs ci grub/ skyabs mchog rnams kyi gsung brtag gang babs kyi sku rim rnams mdzad song yang phan ngo ma blangs par sa skyong lcam dral sar rgyu mtshan 'bul du btang song ba de 'phral sku zhabs mkhan rin po che dang lhan cig mchod yon rnams 'dzom thog pho brang du byon nas gsung brtag bskyar zhus kyi sku rim bsgrubs song yang bzlog tu med par sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang song bas/ sku zhabs rnam gnyis dang nged rang bcas kyi 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyor bgyis/ sngar gyi rmi lam 'gram rus 'dra ba de tshul 'di'i snga ltas su snyam/ bdag gis kyang gsol dgung ma rdzogs par cho ga 'don/ de mtshams bdag gi mig bsgrigs pa 'tsho byed lhu 'dos la bcos su yod tshul dang rim gro dgos rigs bcas mkhan chen dam pa'i bka' lung phebs pas/ rim gro dgos rigs bsgrubs zin pa dang mkhan chen nyid nas snga phyi'i bka' bsgo phrin bcol gnang ste gza' tshes dge bar 'tsho byed lhu 'dos mig 'byed byas pas dang po shin tu gsal ba zhig byung yang zhag gsum tsam nas gdon bgegs lta bus mthong dka' ba byung*/ de skabs rmi lam du rab gsal nas bltas pas pha ri'i zhing kha der grub thob thang stong rgyal po dre'u dkar po zhig chibs nas der bzhugs/

bdag kyang sdod sa nas der skad cig la slebs 'dug pas khyed rang la bar chad zhig yod 'dra gsungs nas chab gsang mdzad pa ma mthong yang gsang chab kyi rnam pa dkar yol gang gnang byung ba rang gi yid la bar gcod ci yod kyang 'di 'thung bas sel 'gro snyam pa nas btung ba dang gnyid sad pas grub chen yang yal song*/ lo 'dir dpal sa skya'i gsung brtag la kho bo'i srog phyar 'tshubs cha yod tshul phebs pa ltar lag rtsa 'tshubs shin tu che zhing*/ chu 'bam gang yin ma nges pa'i nad babs lji ba zhig gi zin pas rim gro spang dag lta bur bgyis/ lan cig rmi lam du gnyer mgon po chos bzang lta bu zhig gis sna drangs nas dngul mda' dgon chen du song ba rmis pas chos skyong gi phrin las su go ba ltar/ sde dge'i drung nas mi ring bar dgon chen du 'gro chog pa'i sku tshab bsod nams 'phel btang byung ba lhun grub steng gi grwa pa nyi shu skor gyi 'do lir bteg ste lhun grub steng du slebs pas/ de 'phral rim gro rgya che ba dang 'tsho byed pad dbang gis 'bam nad yin par ngos zin nas sman bcos kyis nad gzhi rim gyis bde ba dang*/ mig g.yas pa bcos byas pa'ang dngos po'i gzugs phra rags mthong ba bcas je gsal du gyur pas re zhig bcad rgyar gnas/ de mtshams rang gi pha yul ldan phyogs su lta skor tsam phyin nas mchod khang du rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog sogs glegs bam phyed bzhi brgya tsam bzhugs pa'i drung du mchod 'bul mang du bstar/ tshe bh+rūm̐ gdan sar rang gi slob dpon karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal ba'i gser sku bzhugs khang bcas dang*/ rang gi brtsams phud tshul du bstan 'gyur dkar chag gi glegs bam/ mdun chas rdor dril/ ting bdun/ mar me'i kong bu bcas rnams gtan 'jog dang bstod pa rgyun chags tshogs 'don du 'dzugs pa sogs bgyis/ gzhan yang chu nyin srib kun tu lha khang gsar bzhengs sogs kyi rab gnas skor gyi sbyin bdag so so'i re ba bskangs nas rgyal khab 'dir 'byor/

don gnyer rnams kyi ngor/ dbang lung dang gsar rtsom dgos pa rnams spel mar byas/ sde dge lcam dral rnams la zla gcig bar dbang khrus rigs kyang phul/ shar chen mkhan rin po che'i phrin las kyi cha shas yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde gsar btab kyi gtsug lag khang gi rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag dang dgon gnas kyi bca' yig skor sogs phyag mdzod bla ma shes rab bzang po pa'i gsung bskul bzhin brtsams/ rjes su nged ru dam chu tshan zhar la lha rgyal dgon gsar du rab gnas zhig la 'ong dgos tshul nan gyis gsung ltar phyin/ dgon pa'i bla chos rnams nas bsu ba ser sbreng sogs gzab pa mdzad/ gza' tshes dge ba'i nyin kye rdor la bsten pa'i rab gnas bgyis/ shar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs bskyed mdzad phrin rmad du byung bas dgon pa 'di phyi yi sa chu ri dpyad sogs shin tu legs shing*/ nang gi gtsug lag khang chos sde bcas bkod legs pa dpal sa skya gong nas kyang rten gsum gyi nang gzhug byin rten gyi rigs khyad 'phags skor dang dgon pa'i mtshan srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du stsal zhing*/ chos dung srid zhi'i yid smon gnang ba bcas phrin las rgyas po 'byung 'dra snyam pa'i spro ba skyes so// kho bos kyang dri gtsang khang du rigs byed ma'i don kun grub pa'i ril bu dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo bcas bsgrubs pa'i byin can gter du sbas/ gos 'phan cha dang sbub chal cha/ 'khar rnga bcas phul yid lhung dpon sras bla ma rin chen chos rgyal la 'gan sbyar bzang gos sbubs shan can dang mdzod btags 'dus tshogs la mang ja dang gral 'gyed bstabs nas lugs gnyis kyi bslab ston gang nges bgyis/ der bzhugs bla ma dge 'dun kun la 'jigs byed rgyu dbang tshan drug gshar/ kun rig dbang dang mgon dkar rjes gnang sogs tshan che ba bgyis/ yid lhung ba stod smad kun gyi khrom tshogs la chos sbyin gyi 'brel 'jog dang*/

dpon tshang gtsos sngar gyi dad can sbyin bdag so so'i 'bod par phyin nas dbang khrid lung sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi re ba bskang*/ g.yag ze dgon pas bos par bla ma ye shes rdo rje gtsos 'dus tshogs la dzaṃ dmar rjes gnang phul/ tshur lam rdzogs chen dgon du nyi grags sprul sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su 'ong dgos tshul ltar phyin nas gsal 'debs dang kun rig gi sgrub mchod btang*/ bla dgon rnams kyi bzhed pa bzhin mi ring bar yang srid phebs pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs kyang bris/ de ga'i gdan sa pa rgya rong dbon dam pa rang gi gsar bsgrigs steng nas khro chu'i lung zhus/ de mtshams rgyal khab chen por slebs nas rang gi dbon ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub can la sgra ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor ming le/ da phan/ kun bshad/ kṛta bcas tshang ma'i ri mo sdeb sbyor mtha' dag bcas dang*/ snyan ngag le'u gsum ga yongs rdzogs zhib pa bslab khrid bgyid tshe go rtogs shin tu sla ba zhig byung bas blo ldan gyi rtser son gzhan phan can zhig 'byung ba 'dug snyam spro ba skyes/ rigs dbon de nyid grwa sar bteg pa'i nyer bsdogs bla ma yi dam bstan srung rnams la phrin bcol skor dang 'bul tho sogs bzos/ gzhan ma'i bca' bsgrigs zhib pa bgyis nas nged rang chab tshan 'gro ba dang lhan cig khro khog la bteg ste dgon yul la chos sbyin dang*/ rdzong chen dgon pas ser sbreng bcas kyi bsus par mgon dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang bgyis/ zil phrom phyogs su ri khrus gsol ba sogs bgyis pas dge mtshan du mngon pa byung*/ rigs dbon la tshe sgrub dbang brgya bsags nas rma rong tsha khar bteg de nyin dbon por dur khrod bdag po'i dbang bka' bsgo sogs gzab pa byas/ phyi nyin dbon dpon g.yog yar bteg nas bdag zhag shas bar chab tshan bgyis nas phyir 'khor ba dang*/ phur pa bla ma'i ngor bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub dkyil gsar bsgrigs brtsams nas/

sku zhabs mkhan rin po che sa phur gyi chos rje gnyis/ dpal spungs kun khyab sogs la dbang kha shas phul/ sa skya'i bla mar tshe dbang lcags sdong ma phul/ karma zha nag sprul pa'i sku khams phyogs 'dir chibs kha bsgyur ba'i skabs/ sang nyin rgyal khab 'dir phebs rgyu'i snga nub nga rang gi rmi lam du/ kho bo'i mdun der gang nas byung ma mthong ba'i klu sdings zhabs phyir sngar khams la 'ong myong ba'i em mchi skya bo de 'dra ba'i a bo zhig bsdad 'dug pa des dpal spungs pa la gnyen nye ring mang po zer ba nga rang gi dbon bsam gtan ma gtogs su med snyam mur/ a bo de yar langs nas nged kyi gtor sgam thad de nas se na shu bha s+ya kā ya ku la ts+tshin+na nye zer nas bar snang du yal song ba rmis pas ngos kyang sems khral che ba zhig byung song*/ yang skabs shig sde dge'i sras snyung gzhi'i zug che ba zhig gis gtses skabs ngos la'ang brtag pa dgos gsungs pa bzhin sku rim tho zhig phul/ nub gcig rmi lam du tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa'i thub dbang sku thog tshad tsam zhig nga rang gi phyi bdar byed pa'i skabs sa skyong yab rje bstan pa tshe ring dang*/ da lta'i par dpon kun dga' chos 'phel gnyis gang yin ngo mi shes pa zhig sku de'i rgyab nas yar langs nas da dung 'di la srubs 'di 'dra 'dug ces lag pa 'gro sa 'ga' re bstan byung bas/ bdag gis khro pa'i rta mgrin 'dra ba'i ban+de zhig la khyod kyis 'dir shog tsan+dan gyi 'jim pas bug pa 'di rnams 'ga' re bsub grogs kyis zhes 'bod pa'i snang ba byung bas de tshul sa skyong chen por zhus pas rjes su sku rim stobs chen mdzad song*/ de'i snga lo zhig sde dge mdun chen snyung bab lji tsam zhig gi zin nas rdo kham lha khang la bskor ba mdzad skabs ngos kyi mdzod btags dang dngul rdis tshad bzhag nas sku rkyen che ngo shar bas sku rim dgos tshul tho gsal phul ltar mdzad song bas/

zhag gsum gyi mtshams su rmi lam tu nga rang ldan sa dkar gyi rgya sgo steng nas phar gling gseb du ltad mo blta bsam par pu shu'i steng lag pa bzhag tsam byas 'phral/ bar snang rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi thad nas da lam sde dge'i sku tshe cung zad bsring thal zer ba zhig byung bar/ nga rang gi de zer mkhan su red bsam tsa na gzhan su'ang mthong rgyu mi 'dug phar lcags ri'i nang der mdzes kyi dpa' bo tshe ring 'phel zer ba de 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas mi ring bar sde dge bsnyung las grol ba'i dge mtshan byung*/ phyi rol sde dge'i bka' bzhin rnam sras dang dur khrod sgrub rten bca' ba dang sgab 'dre mnan pa bse rag kha ching bcas byas/ de skabs lhun grub phun tshogs kyi ngor bris pa'i rang gi rnam thar lnga thang 'dra 'bag bcas la kho bo dbur bzhugs kyi bla ma bdun phrag gis kye rdor rab gnas rgyas pa yon bdag bgo ba mjug tu legs pa'i 'bel gtam bcas bgyis/ rdzogs chen rgya rong dbon po zhing gzhan du gzigs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub par yong dgos tshul byung ltar phyin/ rdzogs chen gdan sa'i sprul sku bsgres gzhon rnam gnyis dang ngos kyi dbon sprul bcas la kye rdor rgyu dbang phul/ rgya rong dbon sprul myur 'byon gyi smon lam dgos gsungs ltar brtsams/ sprul sku gnyis gtsos der bzhugs 'dus tshogs spyi la tshe dpag dkar po'i rjes gnang dang spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang bcas phul/ tshur lam ru dam tsha khar chab tshan dang khrom tshogs la dbang sbyin bcas nyin grangs kha shas sgar phabs pa dbus 'gros dbon dge legs dpon g.yog gtsang dbus nas chos mjal gegs med grub ste phyir 'khor ba'i bang chen 'byor/ de mtshams sgar bteg nas yong ba'i 'khor lo mdor dbon dpon g.yog dang ngos phrad byung ba phyi nyin chabs cig dgon chen du slebs/ khong dpon slob spyir gyis bgrod lam sdod gnas bde bar ma zad 'di skabs gtsang phyogs su 'brum dogs byung ba sogs kyis sa skya gdan sar yang 'grul gcod dam zhing 'jam mgon gong ma rin po che nas bka' chos sogs kyang bka' rgya ma grol ba'i skabs yin 'dug kyang dpon g.yog tshang ma/

gdan sa rin po cher 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa yab sras gsum ka'i zhal snga nas kyi zhal mjal zhib pa dang*/ dbon por ming ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub gnang zhing*/ sger du kye rdor rgyu dbang dang*/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bka' 'bum gras lam 'bras kyi cha lag mang bzhin gyi ljags lung dang*/ gzhan yang bla chas skor sogs gnang sbyin lugs gnyis dang 'brel pa'i dka' lung zhib lhug bcas thugs rje sku drin tshad med pa gnang 'dug zhag shas nas dbon dge legs kye rdor gzhi'i bsnyen pa la zhugs pa'i sngon 'gro lam dus yongs rdzogs shar khrid bcas/ de rjes nas re zhig bar don gnyer ngor dbang chos dang bsnyen mtshams rtsom chos skor sogs spel mar byas/ sa skyong chen po'i bka' lung bzhin dpon stod gtsug lag khang steng gser 'phru 'dzugs par bteg nas/ der rab gnas dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun tshogs dang yul mi bcas la gang 'tsham rjes gnang sogs kyi re ba bskang*/ tshur 'khor bar smar khams sgar nas byon pa'i bla ma ngag dbang bde chen ngor don gnyer kha shas la kye rdor rgyu dbang byed rgyu'i ha lam cha bzhag yod thog 'bam ro 'phar bas/ smar khams bla mas gtso'i bcu skor tsam zhig las don gnyer yod tshad la dbang sbyin ma thub/ sku zhabs si tu rin po che sbrul lo gsar 'char nas phyag rtsa ma bde ba'i stabs bcad rgyar re zhig bzhugs rtsis la sbrul lo'i ston gzhug nas glo bur du rgyal rong phyogs su rgya dmag gi sku rim par rgya ma'i gdan 'dren gyis mi 'byon ka med yod par/ nged nas bsnyung 'dri btang ba'i lan/ nged la'ang don skor 'dir ci 'gyur brtag pa dgos tshul dang seng gdong bsnyen pa 'dug dgos tshul sogs rten bcas gnang ba'i kho bos bka' don ma bzlog tsam dkon mchog blo gtad kyi brtag dpyad bgyis par/

'byon dgos min ma nges kyang*/ gong ma'i lung gis bskos pa'i rgya dpon rnams thugs mi mnyes par 'gyur ba'i dogs pa gtan ma shar rung sku phyar 'tshubs cha che tshul dang*/ sku rim rgya ma chung tsam gyi tho gsal phul/ phebs lam 'di nas gnang ba'i nged rang mtshams kyi bar bsrings te zhal mjal gsung thos bzang po byung*/ kaḥthog sprul pa'i skur sgrol dkar rjes gnang phul/ tshur dri med bshags rgyud lung zhus/ yang bskyar bsnyen mtshams bsdoms par/ de skabs si tu'i sku phyar mi legs pa'i rmi ltas zhig kyang byung ba yun ma 'gyangs par phebs lam nas sku zhi bar gshegs 'dug pa'i dgongs rdzogs su lhun grub steng gi 'dus tshogs kyi dbur 'gro dgos tshul bzhin phyin nas zab dgongs chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i cho ga zhus/ de nas re zhig bar ngos 'phrad dbang chos sogs don gnyer tsho'i re ba bskangs/ mkhar dbon po chos skyong bsam 'grub ngor don gnyer 'ga' la 'jigs byed rgyu dbang dang las gshin rjes gnang stsal du sbrul lor sde dge'i bang mi sa skyar song ba slebs gdong*/ bdag la bka' lung phebs nang 'di lor mi dwogs kyang slar don brgyad steng 'tshubs tshul dang rim gro nyung shas 'dug pas kho bo'i rkang 'bam zla nang cung 'phar bas/ mkhar dbon gyi sman zos pas 'gyang min nad las grol/ rang gis kyang mo brtag bgyis pa'i rim gro gang dgos byas mkhan chen pa'i lung brtag sogs gang bab dang phyi lor dmigs pa'i sa skya'i bka' lung nang 'khod gtsos rim gro rgya ma chung tsam bsgrubs nas/ sde dge mchod yon lcam bcas drung phyi lor dwogs tshul zhu yig zhib pa 'dzin rnam rgyal gling sgar thog phul 'di lor bdag khu dbon spar kha sogs la 'dzem dgos pa su yang med phyir/ nga rang gi gcen po mkha' 'gro skyabs kyi phung po sreg chog byas na snyam nas sku zhabs mkhan chen zhabs drung du gsung brtag zhus par yang rung bar phebs pa bzhin kun dga' blo gsal dang kun bzang grags pa gnyis btang bar zla tshes la sreg chog dang*/

rim gyis rus pa bkru sbyong sāts+tsha sogs mtha' tshang dgos tshul gyi bkod pa byas/ de nas mtshams kyi bcad rgya'i skabs yin yang*/ sku se rdzong dpon don 'grub bkra shis snyung bab lji stabs lhun steng srib dgon nang grwa khang du seng ge sgra'i gdon 'grol sogs dgos tshul gyi 'bod par byung yang lan gnyis tsam dgongs pa zhus/ de rjes gnyer pa gu ru don 'grub kyis nang mi tshang mas dbang gsan 'dun gyis nan zhus byas byung tshe/ rang blo la da lam 'gro dgos byung na mi legs snyam pa'i dogs pa byung yang*/ yon mchod 'das bzhugs mang po'i ring nas chos dam tshig gi 'brel zab che gshis bka' bzlog ma spobs par 'gro thag bcad par/ 'gro dgos dbang du song na 'chi bslu zhig ma byas phan mi thogs snyam pa zhig shar bas/ zla tshes la dpon don 'grub bkra shis kyi ched du 'chi bslu byas par de nyin bdag dka' tshegs shin tu che snyam zhig byung bar/ sngon nas lag rtsa bde mo yod kyang de'i dgongs mo lag rtsa bltas pas cung 'tshub sdod byung 'dug ste/ zla

1 tshes 29 par dbang sogs gang 'tsham gyi dad ldan rnams kyis re ba 'gengs par bgyis/ tshes 7 la mkhan chen drung sme brtsegs kyi dbang khrus phul bar song bas/ tshes bcur nyi ma me bzhi 'grub sbyor nyin tshe dbang zhig dgos pa'i bka' gnang byung bas/ der bteg grub thob lugs kyi tshe dbang dgung grangs zhig 'bul grub par da lam de tsam zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu byung ba skal ba re bzang snyam nas blo bde ba byung*/ de skor brel ba chod mtshams nas tshes 13 la lhag pa lag sor 'grub sbyor 'dzom nyin gong ma rin po che'i bka' lung phebs nang bzhin rnam rgyal ma'i bsnyen mtshams kyi bcad rgyar zhugs/ par dpon kun dga' chos 'phel la tshe sgrub dbang so lnga tsam phul/ mtshams gtor dang rgyun gtor la spu nag cing snum pa re rer yal ga mang po rgyas pa byung*/ bsnyen mtshams grol nye skabs yid lhung dpon sras rin chen chos rgyal gyi dbon po ci snga dkar ldom la phebs grun legs gsungs zhu yig byung bas/ dbon pos nged la bsnyen pa grol ba dang lhan cig khu dbon ru dam chab tshan bar 'byon/ de nas nged dpon slob yid lhung sogs 'gro na e dga' zer yang*/ bdag mtshams grol nas re zhig rlung sbyang dang 'gros byang byed/ rkang 'bam 'di'ang bab mi 'ong ba'i nges pa med pas zla ba bdun pa'i nang bar mi 'gro/ de bas khyed rang ci snga yid lhung la 'byon tshur lam khro sogs nas 'dir mi btang gyis dang chab tshan la bteg 'gab min gsal 'ong tshul bkod pa bgyis/ me ling sgar thog a 'phel rta len btang nas dbon lha rgyal drung la'ang de mtshungs zhu yig phul/ dbon dge legs dpon slob zla 7 tshes 11 la dkar ldom bteg de'i tshes 13 la'ang lhag pa lag sor 'grub sbyor 'dug pas bsnyen mtshams grol rgyu'i nub mor rmi lam du/ nga rang tshogs chen zhig gi dkyil na chos khrims sdod sa'i steng der bsdad 'dug pas/

dge slong zhig gi yar bzhugs zer bar tshogs pa'i gzhung de na phyin par 'don pa sogs ci yang mi byed 'dug mod/ nga rang gi dge 'dun sde'i dbus su zhugs zer ba de 'di yin pa 'dra bsam zhing*/ de 'phral dge slong zhig tshogs pa'i dkyil nas yar langs te skad gsang mthon pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan// snang byed tshul khrims rin chen bskal pa'i bar// rga na med pa'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas// bstan dang sems can kun la phan byed shog /zhes zer ba zhig byung ba rang gi yid la tshig bzang po de 'dra zhig brjod song snyam pa'i spro snang de ga'i mur gnyid sad pa 'di phyi gang rung gi bden smon yin par mngon/ yang zhag shas mtshams nas gnas gar yin ma nges pa zhig nas zer mkhan mthong rgyu med par/ tshul khrims rin chen khyed da lam 'chi/ cis kyang 'chi/ nges par 'chi zer ba zhig rmi lam la byung*/ de nas rkang 'bam 'phar ba lta bu'i gzugs gzhi bab lji ba dang*/ dbugs kha rgod pa sogs yang 'dug pa/ lha rje pad dbang dang grwa chung gnyis kyi sman bza' khul bgyis/ sa dbang mdun rin po cher gnas tshul phul bas zhabs phyi ched btang gi nad 'dri stsal/ dpal sa skya dang ngor pa'i rten 'dus byin rten rigs/ sangs rgyas 'phel gdung lan grangs bcas myong zhing yid la gang dran gyi smon lam btab/ klu sdings mkhan rin po che'i drung du gsung brtag lan grangs bzhi tsam zhus pa sogs kyis rim gro snga phyi mang du sgrub/ mkhan chen drung nas dngul rdil tshad kyi nad 'dri rten stsal ba dang*/ tshogs su ring 'tsho'i rnam rgyal stong mchod mdzad song*/ gzhan yang sa dbang chen po'i gnyer blon drung 'khod pa rnams gtsos mchog phal mang po nas rim gro rten bstsal zhing ring 'tsho'i 'dun pa mi lhod pa dgos tshul dang*/ lhun grub steng gi bla ma grwa byings nas ngos kyi rim gror rang rang gi ngag 'don du dam bca' mdzad mi rnams kyi grangs bcad byung ba rnams phyogs bsdoms dkon mchog rjes dran tshar brgya dang bcu/

bi rū pa'i sku bstod tshar nyis stong chig brgya bcu/ rje btsun gyi sku bstod 'khri shing ma brgya tshar/ bsam pa lhun grub tshar lnga bcu/ ngor chen sku bstod rab dkar ma tshar brgya tham pa/ dpal ldan chos skyong gsol 'debs bdun brgya brgyad cu/ klu sdings mkhan chen la gsol 'debs tshar brgya/ ngos kyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad tshar nyis brgya/ tshe gzungs chig stong dgu brgya/ tshe mdo brgya tham pa/ mtshan brjod tshar nyis brgya sum cu/ yig brgya chig stong*/ rnam 'joms lnga brgya nyi shu/ sgrol bstod nyi khri dgu stong drug brgya bzhi bcu/ sher snying brgya tshar/ ma ṇi bye ba gcig dang sum khri chig stong*/ 'byung 'dul snying po dgu 'bum chig khri chig stong bzhi brgya/ phur pa'i snying po nyi khri/ seng gdong snying po chig 'bum lnga khri bzhi stong chig brgya/ gnas brtan phyag mchod tshar brgya dang bco lnga/ ltung bshags nyis stong sum brgya/ bzang spyod nyis brgya dang nga bdun/ 'gro la bde skyid kyi 'dod gsol tshar drug brgya/ lha sa la bskor ba dam bca' nyis brgya/ lhun grub steng gling bskor brgya tham pa/ lhun grub steng gi mchod rten mang bskor drug brgya/ bskang gso brgya rtsa gnyis rnams dang*/ grangs bcad med par 'don bya gong du smos pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gong ma lnga bstod dang thang stong pa'i sku bstod/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs/ rigs gsum snying po/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gzungs/ lo ma gyon ma'i snying po/ smon lam rnam lnga rnams ci mang dang gang tshar gyi dam bca' mkhan bdun cu tsam gyis bla ma dang slob ma'i 'dun pa tshul bzhin gyis ring por 'tsho bar bskul mod/ de rnams kyis kyang phan bskyed med pa'i khams ji lji las mi 'dug pas/ bu slob rnams kyi nged la mkhan chen gdan drangs tshe dbang sogs gang 'gab zhus na legs zer bas rjes su yi rang yang*/ gzhan bka' dbang gang yang thugs sun zhu dgos med/

kun rig dbang phyir bzlog bcas shig zhu dang gson na 'tsho rim/ shi na sgrib sbyong de las lhag pa mi dgos gdams nas zla 6 tshes 29 la kun rig dbang phyir bzlog bcas zhus/ yang bu slob rnams kyi re ba bskang phyir tshes 1 la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang dang*/ skyabs mgon nyid kyi brtag bab seng ge sgra'i gdon 'grol tshes 7 la stsal ba bka' drin bsam 'das byung yang*/ sku zhabs sku gcong ba sogs kyis 'o brgyal che song snyam pa'i sems khral che ba byung*/ dbon lha rgyal dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi gsung bris phebs nang khyed rang gi mo brtag gyis gsungs byung ste/ rang rtsar thug dus rogs ces pa'i dpe ltar gang gzan dgos pa med tshul dang*/ gong ma rin po che dang shar chen pa'i lung brtag gis ma chog pa med bsam gyis btang snyoms su bzhag bu slob rnams kyi yang bskyar nan bskul byas kyang nged 'tsho thub na bzang shi na'ang bstan don ma grub bsam pa ma mchis pas/ rang gzhan su la'ang gtan nas 'gyod pa dgos pa'i dus la ma bab pas brtag mo sogs bka' tshegs gang che dgos pa med tshul gyi bkod pa byas/ lhun grub phun tshogs la yang sdug bsngal ma byed des phan pa med tshul dang*/ khyod rang gi bsam pa dkar pos nged la zhabs 'degs ma grub pa ci yang med pas sems 'tshing nges yin tshul sogs slad char gyi bslab bya zhib pa yi ge bcas dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag skye ba'i phreng bar mi 'bral ba'i bden smon btab nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa byed tshul bgyis/ khyod rang gis rdzong chen dgon bla ma mchod chog gtan 'jog bzhag pa de bdag nam 'chi song na tshes dus ma 'phyugs par rgyun du btang na legs tshul gdams/ gnas brtan rtogs brjod rtsom 'phro lus pa gro bzhin zla 7 tshes 1 la grub pa/ ma 'ongs par rgyal bstan spyi bye brag la sman 'dogs che bar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel dge mtshan du mngon pas/

bstan bcos de nyid dang bdag gi rnam thar sogs kyi lung tshang ma/ dbon dge legs la 'phrod par byas/ gong ma rin po che'i bka' lung phebs par sa skyar 'byon dgos byung na snyam pa sogs kyis dbon por lugs gnyis kyi kha ta gang nges gdams/ yang dbon ser skya gsum grwa rigs bcas la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ma 'ongs so so'i bslab bya byas/ dbon po gsum kar kha sems gcig cing bya ba gang brtsam lam 'gro sogs kyi bka' bsgo nan tan dang bstan srung tshogs la phrin bcol bcas brtsams so// sa ngor a bo'i 'byor lan nang*/ rje btsun sa skya gong ma rin po che'i drung la/ bdag nad bab lji tshul dang mi rtag par gyur na'ang yang srid blo ldan bstan phan can e 'byung gi blo gtad bgyis yod tshul dang bstan srung tshogs la snyan shal 'dod gsol bcas bris pa dang*/ dad sgrol chen po yab sras sku tshe bskal par brtan cing bstan srid rgyas pa'i bden smon sogs kyis rgyas btab ste phul/ sa skyong chen po lcam dral/ lcam sku mched bcas la bdag cag gi deng par zhabs 'degs grub lugs dang phyir sku drin che tshul dang*/ da 'byung dpon ser skya grwa rigs bcas la bka' drin che bskyang mkhyen zhes tshes 8 la zhu yig 'di ltar phul/ bka' drin gzhal med chos ldan sa skyong chen po'i zhabs stegs su/ ma nges pa'i zhu bya/ dpal sa skya'i brtag bab kyi keg bzlog dang*/ deng mkhan chen pa'i gsung brtag sngon rjes bar gsum dang mo pra zhig la gang bab rim gro rnams grub grabs yin yang*/ de sngon ni rang gi lus nyams sogs yar bde ni 'ong rgyu mi 'dug lha rje gnyis kyi nad gzhi 'di chu 'bam nyis bsdong ngos bzung dang lag rtsa rtsub tshul bcas gsungs pa ltar na/ de sngon rim gro sman bcos kyis phan bskyed cher ma 'ong ba 'dra ba dang*/ 'di lor bdag gi srog phyar/ dpal sa skya'i lung brtag la 'tshub ngo shar ba bcas kyi ci 'gyur ma nges tshe dogs pa che bas zhu ba yin ma gtogs/

nga rang gi skyon min ga la shes thub pas zhu tshod ma thengs kyang*/ gal srid 'tsho 'chi ci gyur yang*/ mdun rin po che lcam dral nas dgongs 'jag gnang bar gsol ba 'debs don/ bdag cag ni sde dge yab chen bde bar gshegs pa'i ring nas bzung deng bar du yon mchod rnams kyi bka' lung gang phebs ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs rnams kyi zhabs phyi zhus pa thams cad gegs bral grub khul dang*/ sa dbang dam pa gshegs bzhugs rim byon gyis kyang bla'i mchod gnas su bkur ba'i brtse gzigs bdag rkyen chen po mdzad pa las nam du'ang dgongs par mi 'bab par ma gnang*/ phyis su rang mig bsgribs pa dang lo grangs sogs kyi zhabs 'degs chen po grub rgyu mi 'dug kyang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam dag gis gtor bsngo sogs kyi skabs su/ sa dbang sde dge'i bstan srid rgyas pa dang*/ yab sras lcam rnams kyi sku tshe phrin las dbang thang rgyas pa'i phrin bcol dang bsrung 'khor dmigs gnad gzab gtad zhabs 'degs rnam kun bgyis khul yin lags/ mdun lcam dral nas brtse gzigs bdag rkyen che ba'i khar za ma zos pa bcas kyi sku drin bsam mi khyab pa 'khor thabs ma mchis kyang*/ da 'byung thugs rje mi chung bar snyan sgron 'bul rgyu la bdag gi pha mes ring nas bdag yan bstan par phan pa'i mi rgyud blo ldan rim pa byung don/ bar skabs su mi rtsa phra bas nged kyis bstan srung rnams la phrin bcol bka' gtad gang zab byed dgos byung ba'i thugs rjes tsha bo byung ba 'di gsum gyi nang nas/ dge gsar nor bu 'di shes rab che zhing rig gnas skor yang nga rang gi ci shes bslab tshar bas khong rang gis sbyang pa byas na chog pa yod pas re ba che phyir slob gnyer sogs chud mi za ba'i 'go 'dren bdag rkyen dang*/ tsha bo chung ba sprul sku yin zer ba 'di yang da lta byis par song bas bya lag rgod pa ma gtogs bag chags bzang zhing blo rno ba can zhig yod pas slob gnyer lob pa sogs gang ci'i bdag rkyen dang*/
