tsha bo skya bo 'di slar mi rgyud blo ldan e 'byung re bas de sngon bar rang rtsar nyar tshags byas pa yin pas zhabs phyi mtho dman gang du bzhag na dbu rnar dgongs pa'i bdag rkyen dang sa dkar gyi khang zhing*/ rtswa mtsher/ nor rdzas phran bu yod pa bcas la mi rtsa yod med kyi bya ba byed mkhan byung na'ang thugs rje bdag rkyen dbu na ci mdzad bdag po rin po ches byams brtse'i gzigs pas skyong bar mkhyen mkhyen/ na nyin phyis tshod bdag gi 'tsho rim mang po dang dbon po grwa sar brdzang ba sogs kyis dngos rdzas che ba ma mchis kyang*/ gang yod rnams btang tshod bzhag tshod ci mdzad na bdag po rin po che nyid nas bkod khyab gang 'tsham gnang ba'i bka' drin mi chung ba mkhyen/ grwa rigs 'di rnams kyang sngar nas rang gi blo gtad bgyis pa'i beb tshod kyi mi kho na yin pas dbu rna mdzad nas brtse skyong dang bdag rkyen mi chung bar dbon po che chung gi grwa 'khor du gnas pa zhig thugs rje mdzad pa mkhyen mkhyen lags/ zhu 'degs lha dar dkar po bcas sa skyong chen po'i zhabs 'bring pa zhu dag bla ma tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'da' ka'i zhal chems su phul ba lags so// zhes pa phul bar/ sa dbang rin po che lcam dral zhabs drung nas bka' lung 'di bzhin bstsal byung bar/ bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon skyabs mchog thams cad gzigs pa'i zhabs pad du/ gus pas zhu ba/ da lam sku khams rin po che bde dogs gnas tshul gyi gsung shog phebs nang bzhin/ sku nyid bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par 'di ga'i bstan srid 'di phyi gang sar shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i mdzad phrin gyis sku drin bsam gyis mi khyab par brten/ da lam 'jam mgon gong ma rin po che dang sku zhabs mkhan chen dam pa'i bka' lung bcas la gang bab kyi sku rim zhabs brtan mtha' dag grub mtshams 'di bzhin/ da dung bdag sogs gdul byar gzigs pa'i zhabs pad bskal par brtan pa'i thugs dam mi lhod par gsol ba 'debs shing gal srid bstan 'gro bsod nams dman pa'i dbang du gyur na yang*/

nged rang mchod yon dam tshig sel med thugs nang khyad par can dag par brten pa'i/ dbon ser skya gsum gyi 'go 'dren dgon yul bdag thob kyi sa khang shing*/ ri rtswa mtsher mig grwa rigs bcas pa'i 'dzin skyong 'go 'dren rgyab gnyer dang*/ phyag rdzas 'thor god mi 'gro ba'i don smin bcas zhabs 'gyur dgongs pa rdzogs nges zhu rgyu dang*/ kun dga' chos 'phel la yang de bzhin gyi zhib tshags blta dpyad dgos pa'i bkod sbyar byed pa lags pas de lugs chos klong rin po cher bsti ba zhu zhu/ zhu yig 'degs mtshon bcas sga mchu sgar nas zhu yig dpon lha rgyal dang sangs rgyas/ gnyer gu ru don 'grub/ gu ru tshe brtan bcas la de mtshungs zhu yig gang 'os phul/ klu sdings bla ma phyag mdzod shes rab bzang por/ shar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs 'degs phul byung de sngon grub pa ltar/ da dung yang sku tshe dang phrin las 'phel rgyas thabs tshul la mi lhod par 'dzin skyong dgos tshul gyi zhu yig rten bcas phul/ zhe drung bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan can slob ma'i gtso bor gyur pa slan chad rig gnas sogs brtson 'grus dgos tshul dang*/ nged kyi tha ma'i bka' 'bum sogs grogs dan dgos pa'i yi ge springs/ lcam sku mched snga mo nas dngos phrad cig la phebs 'dod che 'dug kyang 'grul 'dzem kyis ji bzhin ma bde/ slar mkhan chen drung du sa dbang chen po'i mdun nas lcam sku mched nged sar phebs na nyes yod med kyi gsung brtag zhus par/ 'byon na nyes med tshul gyi brtag yig phul bar brten/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi snga char 'di gar phebs byung ba de 'phral mjal phrad byas/ lcam lhan rgyas nas dngul srang bcu'i gtsos pa'i tshan grangs bcu gcig tsam gyi gnang cha dang*/ lcam nor 'dzin dbang mor/ nged nas mgon po'i chos skor sogs gsang khrid kha shas phul ba de don skor la dgongs pa'i thub dbang sku rgya bzo/

rdor dril cha/ gos ser 'brug brgya mas sbubs shan byas pa'i tshar slog rnams gnang byung*/ nged rang nas kyang lcam mched la bka' bsgo nan tan byas/ lcam nor 'dzin dbang mos sprul sku myur 'byon phrin bcol sngon du zhus byung ba brtsams grub pas de nyid lhan rgyas su lung phul/ nged rang nas da dgos dbon ser skya sogs la 'go 'dren dgos tshul zhu bya rags bsdus dang sngags mdud phul/ lcam gnyis nas kyang rje bla ma'i bka' stsal ltar zhabs 'gyur zhu zhes dang*/ slad char skye nas tshe rabs bar rjes su bzung dgos tshul sogs bslab ston shin tu rgyas po mdzad 'dug tshes bcu gsum gyi nam langs rgyab lho 'gros kyi sde dge gzhung gi sku tshab bsod nams rab brtan dpon gnyer sogs la mjal kha dang bkod pa nyung shas bgyis/ nyi shar lhun grub steng gi bla ma dge 'dun bzhugs tshad dang yul mi sogs stong phrag phyed gnyis tsam la ngos phrad byin rlabs bgyis/ 'di nyin me tog gi char 'bab 'dug ces bla ma kun dga' bsod chen gtsos kun gyi gleng skad grags/ bdag gi srung 'khor dang rgyun gtor 'bul skabs su sa skyong chen po yab sras lcam rnams dang dbon lha rgyal khyad med kyis dus kun bsrung bya dang 'dod gsol bgyid pa'i gtso bo sbyin bdag dad 'dun can khyad 'phags yin pas/ nged kyi skra tshang ma zhig dad rten ched du 'phrod dgos tshul gdams/ par dpon kun dga' chos 'phel la yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung*/ rgyun bgrang bo dhi tse'i phreng ba/ dar dkar bcas phul nas/ rang gi sngar nas deng bar bstan pa dang sems can gyi don dang*/ sde dge'i zhabs phyi ma grub bsam pa med tshul sogs rang bzhin 'phros mol zhib pa dang*/ rjes shul gyi 'go 'dren dgos tshul sogs zhu bya gang dgos dang*/ bla ma kun dga' bsod chen la'ang de mtshungs kyi skad cha zhib par byas/ gos stod zhig phul/

nye gnas lhun grub phun tshogs la zhabs phyi 'grub pa dang*/ rten 'brel dgos ched du rgya dril bzang ba zhig sbyin rgyu dang*/ nged kyi dpe khrod tshan gnyis re yod pa re re sbyin dgos dang*/ gzhan dpe cha lta rtogs ci dgos na khong rang la bkag 'gog med par g.yar gnang byed dgos tshul dbon por bkod sbyar bgyis/ kun dga' blo gsal la dpe chas mkho med kyang dngul srang lnga tsam sbyin rgyu dang*/ ngag dbang dpal bzang*/ kun bzang grags pa/ a 'phel gsum la gos mal re gnang dgos dang*/ rang gi grwa slob chos rje kun dga' bsam gtan sar bdun gcig bar du bstan srung la phrin bcol dgos lung sogs bkod pa dang*/ gos stod phul/ shākya chos 'phel la yang nga rang gi rgyun bgrang phreng ba byin nas rjes kyi bkod pa bgyis/ khong rang nas kyang lam 'bras dus thang bri rgyu'i khas len byed 'dug bris pa bu chung la'ang ster cha phran bu zhig dgos tshul smras/ slar yang bla ma kun dga' bsod chen/ rang gi dbon grwa slob thams cad 'dzom thog kho bo dang por chos sgor zhugs nas thos bsams bgyis tshul/ bstan pa'i bya ba dang*/ sde dge rim phebs kyi zhabs phyi sgrub lugs/ bar skabs su phrag dog can kha shas kyis zos bde min sna tshogs byung rab/ da lta lo grangs don brgyad thog slebs pas/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po gtsos mchog dman tshang ma mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin kho na yin gshis/ nga rang mi gcig gi ring la tshe tshad dang bya ba gnyis ka sa nas mthar ma phyin bsam pa med dus 'gyod pa sogs gtan nas mi 'tshal zhing*/ da dgos nged kyi dpe cha 'di rnams 'byor dka' ba kho na yin pas bstan pa'i btsas su phan pa'i phyi 'khyar bor 'thor rigs mi 'gro ba shin tu gal che zhing*/ nga rang gi phung po yun ring bzhag na deng sang tshad pas rul sungs yong bas kye rdor dus tha'i cho ga la bsten nas sreg chog mkhan rin po che bzhugs thub yong zhing*/

gal srid ma thub kyang phur pa bla ma rong rgan su 'grigs sreg chog zhus bsreg pa yang nga rang bsti gnas 'dir chog pa byung na legs/ thog mar 'chi lugs sogs lus drangs po'i tshul zhig byung na 'pho ba gsal 'debs sogs kyi skabs stabs bde ba zhig yod kyang*/ deng sang phal cher gyi og mar shing ka brgyab nas ro bzo byas te phyi nas chos gos bsgron ste thugs dam la bzhugs zhes ngom srol 'dug rung*/ de rigs nyes pa bsags pa'i rgyu las med pa de 'dra nged la dgos pa med pas/ thog mar phyi dbugs sdud pa nas drang 'gyel ji ltar gyur kyang bca' bcos sogs gtan nas ma byed par/ don dam du ngos la khyad ma mchis kyang khyed rang tsho'i bltas mdzes kyi khyad du/ mkhan chen dpal chos pa'i snam sbyar dang*/ lo paṇa gyi zhwa de bskon pa sogs byas na chog khyad par de snga phan nga rang gi lam gyi rtsa ba kye rdo rje 'di yin pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs gtan la phabs pa'i lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la sbyangs pa 'dra yang bgyis yod pas dgung gsum bar du kye rdor sgrub mchod byung na bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med bskyed pas thus/ de phan kun rig cho ga btang na byang chog bcas thun mong lugs ji lta ba bzhin gyis dang chog gzhan bla chen rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs sgrub dus byang chog mi byed pa'i srol 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ngan 'gro sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gsungs pa'i dngos bstan sdig sgrib sbyong phyir bsngags pas sa lam gyi sgrib sbyang mi dgos pa zhig med dam sems so// nga zhu dag bla ma zhes grags chen zhig tu song bas lhun grub steng gi tshogs chen la dngos sta sbrel ba'i kye rdor sgrub mchod nyin gnyis pa zhig tshugs na/ khyed rang tsho'i rna ba la yang phan zhing slar gdung 'bum mchod rten 'dra thon na ma 'ongs par chos 'khor bskor ba'i rten 'brel du bkra shis sgo mangs bzhengs pa legs/

'di skor nub gcig rmi lam du gnod pa phyir bzlog zer ba'i dpe cha zhig nga rang gi gsar rtsom bgyis pa shin tu tshig bsgrigs legs pa bcas mthong byung ba rmis pa rgyu mtshan dpyad byar bzhag da dung don gnyer rnams kyi ngor/ dpe cha bzo bcos rgyu kha shas yod kyang da lam nga rang gi bstan bcos brtsams pa'i tha ma gnas brtan rtogs brjod 'di thogs nas 'jog rgyu yin zhing*/ de 'phro gzhan rnams ma 'ongs par rtsom rgyu'i rten 'brel dang bzhugs tshul yang nga rang bstan bcos thams cad kyi mtha' na gnas brtan rtogs brjod/ de 'og nga rang gi rnam thar bzhag rgyu gyis/ rnam thar dang bka' 'bum rnams kyis 'phro bsdu cung zad dgos pa dbon po dge legs kyi byas chog zhing*/ zhe chen drung yig sar yang de dag gi rogs dan zhib pa byed dgos pa'i sngon du yi ge song yod pas de bzhin gyis zhes sogs gang ci'i lugs gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad kha chems tshul gyis bkod khyab bgyis/ mkhar bla ma rin chen brtan pa khu dbon la sngar nas deng bar gyi rgyu mtshan zhib rgyas dang*/ rjes shul rigs dbon sogs la 'go 'dren brtse skyong dgos tshul zhus/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin can sngar nged kyi bka' 'bum par du brko chog pa mdun la zhu 'bul dang 'go 'dren lhod med bgyis pa'i drin chen dad zhen can yin par nged mjal bar dar kha gser srang gang 'bul du byung yang stabs ma bde bas/ rang gi skra tshogs phul nas rgyu mtshan zhur bcug kyang rjes nas ngos phrad dang byin rlabs bka' bsgo bcas 'bul rgyu byung bas spro ba brtas/ bkra shis chos rdzong nas bla ma lhun grub bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' shes rab/ mgon bla dkon mchog chos 'phel rnams byung ba ngos phrad dang byin rlabs bka' bsgo bgyis/ khong rnams nas yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi mchod 'bul yang mdzad song*/ lha rje pad dbang la tshem bu lugs kyi ngag khrid zhib pa sogs byas/

kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum gyi dbu lha'i kha byang rnams brtsams nas bu lugs la bkod sbyar 'dra byas/ par byang gsar rtsom dgos pa dbon ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub la rtsom bcug rten 'brel ched du phyi nang gtsug lag sde snod smra ba mkhas pa'i nyi gzhon zhes pa'i ming byin/ dbon dge legs la bum chus rang gi lus kun khyab par bkru bcug de nub nga rang mdun du ngos mi zin pa'i mi tshogs mang pos dga' ba'i nyams byed pa dang rang sems kyang shin tu dga' ba'i nyams zhig byung*/ phyi nyin bco lnga la gnyer mgon po tshe ring dang dpon karma tshang sogs kyis nad 'dri btang bar mjal phyag btang*/ dpal spungs lha bzo karma bkra shis la yang mjal phyag bgyis/ dge slong ting 'dzin rnam rgyal la byin rlabs dang da lta nga rang mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan yang 'gyod pa med do smras/ hor 'dra bkra shis 'phel ngos la dad zhen che ba'i stabs kyis slebs byung ba bka' bsgo smon lam bgyis nas nga rang gi rgyun gon zhig dad rten du byin/ dgos ched zhig gi don phrin bcol gsar rtsom yang bgyi/ nga rang gi byams smon bton nas sa bcu po la rab tu gnas zhes pa'i mtshams su dbon dge legs dang don 'grub bkra shis can gnyis la zang spyod smon lam 'don bcug rjes su yang rang gi smon lam ci 'grub 'debs pa rnams bgyis so// byang chub sems gnyis gru chen legs bzung nas// mtha' med srid pa'i mtsho chen las brgal te// don gnyis 'grub pa'i nor bu'i bstan dang 'gror// phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston ci yang byin// bgrang bya bcu phrag bdun dang bkra shis grangs// thob kun don med ma song lus srog gi /ngal ba khyad du bsad nas rgyal bstan gyi// zhabs 'degs ma grub med snyam zhe blo bde// mnyam med thub pa mchog gtso'i 'dus byas kun// mi rtag chos can yin pas rang nyid kyang*// de la nye snyam 'byung 'gyur bslab bya kun// gdams nas snga lam bgrod pa'i sta gon bgyis// chos smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can rang gi skye ba phal pa'i rkang 'thung dge sdig 'dren ma'i las kyi yal ga phan tshun du 'dzings par bde sdug dus kyi rgyal mos re mos su bsgyur ba'i tshul mchid pa las bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ji snyed bgyis pa dang*/

mthar snga lam du bgrod pa'i nyer bsdogs bgyis tshul bcas sarga ste lnga pa'o// zhes pa 'di yan chad rje rang gi zhal bkod zin ris dngos ma'o// // ༄༅// susopānamārohādhitsaritrakāṣāy+yadh+wādzāpramādabikran+taḥsamātsārasat+t+wārat+nasubar+ṇaṇatābhadrāsanādrahas+yaman+t+rāṇāṃ//

༄༅// lhag pa'i tshulaṃ khrimasaṃ ngur smig rgyal mtshan dag yod them skas la 'dzegs te// rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs khri las sngags spyod riṃn chenaṃ kañca na'i// ༄༅// sahasrāratsakreṇadwibhabaprapañcādz+nyānamaṇ+ḍalādhikarāṇāṃ// munish+shāsanādhar+m+mas+yanṛbeṇagṛh+ṇan+tusmabodhisāratān+wan+taḥ ༄༅// rtsibs stong 'khor los gnyis snang spros kun ye shes dkyil 'khor mnga' mdzad pa'i// yongs rdzogs thub bstan chos kyi rgyal pos byang chub bar du rjes su bzung*// ngaṃg giṃ rab spel gyi rgyan/ dbangaṃ poṃ gzugs gzhan ji bzhin shes bya kun la 'jigaṃs bralaṃ gyi// phyogaṃs laṃs rnamaṃ paṃr rgyalaṃ ba'iṃ spobs pa lhaṃ mchog dbyangaṃs caṃn snyemaṃs paṃ yis// brjod bya'iṃ laṃng tshoṃ dar la bab pa'iṃ sdeṃ snod rgyud sde'i mthar thug don// rgyan gsum lam nas thogs med 'jo bas smra mkhas grags pa srid na dkar// dbyangs mchog rmongs pa'i dpe/ yan lag rdzogs pa'i gdangs las gdul bya'i skal bar nyer 'tshams pa'i// zab rgyas chos 'khor bar med bskor bas ston mchog nyid du rnam brtags te// bral dang rnam smin rmad byung yon tan drug cu bzhi las nyer brtsams te// blo ldan yongs kyis bsngags pa'i gling bu lan cig min par bsgyur ba'i gnas// 'gro ba'i phreng ba'i gsal byed/ phan bde rgyal bstan rin chen las// 'byung mod de yang bstan 'dzin skyes chen las// de yang rgyal rnams thugs rje de dag kyang*// gdul bya dus su smin pa'i skal ba las// des na ljongs gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan/ 'di dam chos snang ba yis// khyab par nye tshe dbang bcu'i bdag nyid rnams// rnam 'dren mchog dang sa dbang sgyu 'phrul du// zhugs pa gna' bo'i mkhan slob chos rgyal mtshungs// dam pa'i zla bo dngos po'i dpe/ grangs su bgrang bya du ma yang*// yongs rdzogs bstan la legs byas khyod 'dra su// 'chi med rdzings ring rgyu dkar grangs med dbus// shar gyi thig le gnyis pa su yis mthong*//

bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyun/ nges par skye 'jig mtha' las rnam grol kyang*// gcig tu mjal dka' mjal ba don chen du// phal dang dam pa'i khyad par ston phyir sogs// dgongs gzhi du mas mdzad pa tha ma bstan// zhes pa ste/ de la bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po/ gzhi so sor thar pa lhag par tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor bzung bas bcas dang rang bzhin gyi ltung byed phra mo tshun chad mig 'bras ltar bsrungs pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog phyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas du ma dang so so ba mkhyen pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa du ma tshul bzhin bsten te shes bya thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba la nang byan chud pas mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum la bsnyengs pa med pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ nang du rang don gces 'dzin gyis srid par yang 'byung gi sa bon bdag tu lta ba gzhom pa'i gnyen po smon 'jug rnam pa gnyis la brten nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ mthar thug bstan pa'i snying po 'bras bu lam du byed pa gsang chen rdo rje'i theg pa'i rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa'i dngos gzhi gzhi smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel pa'i lam grol byed kyi khrid rim bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa phrin las rab 'byams dang bcas pa sbas don rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bla ma'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs kyi gnad dang ldan pa mtshan ldan gyi rdo rje'i slob dpon du ma lus ngag longs spyod kyi sgo nas mnyes par mdzad de lhag ma med par ji ltar nos pa bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ phyi bskyed pa lha'i 'khor los snod bcud gzhal yas dang lha'i 'khor lor shar bas tha mal chags sdang gi snang ba 'gags pa/

bzlas pa sngags kyi rtsal 'byangs pas brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad der 'dzin med par grags stong brjod bral skye 'gag med pa'i gdangs su shar ba/ gnas pa rtsa'i mdud pa phra rags grol te g.yo ba rlung dbu mar chud pas/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems bcu drug gi dga' ba 'gro dang ldog pas lhan skyes ye shes kyi bde bas myos pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug he ru ka chen po/ thun mong gi snang ngor yi dam chos srung la las bcol ba ltar snang yang don du rang snang dbang du 'dus pas gzhan snang la 'dod dgur bsgyur nus pas zhi rgyas dbang drag las rab 'byams mtha' dag ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyud gsum dregs pa bran du 'khol ba la sogs pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog gi bsngags 'os ma lus pa zol sbyor dang sgro btags kyi ngal ba ma dgos pa mngon du gyur pa ste/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ du bas me bzhin rnam thar las// nang gi yon tan legs brtags te// zhes ri yi phag dang ngam grog gi klung lta bu nas du ba 'thon pa na me dngos ma mthong kyang du ba me las skyes pa'i gtan tshigs kyis me yod par rjes su dpag pa ltar/ gong du smos pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnams brjod pa po rang nyid rang blo lkog tu gyur pas 'phags pa rnams kyi dgongs pa 'di dang 'di'o zhes brjod du ga la btub kyang*/ mdo rgyud dri ma med pa nas rnal 'byor mchog gi lam rtags gang dag gsungs pa dang*/ skyabs mchog 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa zhus dag pher ba ltar gyis ci ltar bsngags kyang phul byung dang rab brtags lta bu'i brjod ches pa'i 'ud du 'gyur ba lta zhog gis/ rje 'di nyid dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa zhig ma gtogs so skye phal gyis bskal pa'i mthas gtugs par bsngags kyang yon tan gyi cha shas phra mo tsam yang rdzogs nus bral ba ste/

mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis mkhyen// sa gzhi yi ni lci ba'i tshad// mtha' yas nyid kyis shes par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'di yongs su rdzogs par gyen du btegs na lci bar shes kyang*/ 'di tsam lci zhes rang gis khur ma myong ba la cha med kyi/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas kyis sa chen po 'di phrag pas brtan pa'i phyir lci yang 'di tsam mo zhes shes pa ste/ daṇ+ḍī'i gzhung las/ 'phrog byed kyis ni sa gzhi dag /rmig pas bcad pa'i klu'i brag gis// dmar ba chu yi gter las byung*// zhes pa'i gtam rgyud bzhin la/ de ltar mkhas grub dam pa yin na bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yin pa'i khyab pa yod cing*/ de yin min ni bstan pa la bya ba rlabs che chung gis 'byed pa ste/ de ni tshul ji lta bu zhig bsgrub zhe na/ mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis// bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yis gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo smad nor 'dzin gyi thig ler stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sde dge chos rgyal chen po 'di nyid kyi bdag po'i rkyen la brten nas rje 'di nyid ma phebs gong rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che par du bsgrubs zin mtshams/ slar sa dbang dam pa gong nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung gi dgongs 'grel 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin gyi phyi mo gtsor smos pa/ bstan pa'i btsas su bskrun pa'i thugs bskyed ma thag bdud dang bdud kyi ris mtha' dag gi gnas ni stongs la nye/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi mi ma yin rnams ni gzi brjid dang*/ stobs dang*/ sde dang 'khor du bcas pa ni mngon par dar bas a la la zhes ched du brjod/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis rang nyid kyi bstan pa rma med par bya ba'i ched du mkhyen rab dang nus pa gcig tu bsdus nas rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid mkhas grub dam pa'i rnam pa zhig tu sprul par ni gdon mi za ste/

ci'i phyir na rje 'di nyid ma byon pa'i sngar phan khams phyogs 'di grub mtha' gzhan du bshad grwa tho re ba tsam yod pa 'dug kyang*/ gzhan dag sngags gsar rnying gi bsgom bsgrub kyi grwa tsam ma gtogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa dag ma dag 'byed nus pa'i/ rig pa'i gnas mtshan nyid pa gtan nas med pas/ brtsam chos sogs cung zad byed pa byung ba rnams kyang dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa sogs kyis gzigs tshe khams rtsom yin 'dug gsungs pa'i nyams mtshar bzhad gad kyi gnas su yod kyang*/ rje 'di nyid skyes thob kyi mkhyen rab spra ba rlan med pa la me stag phra mos reg pa tsam nas de ma thag 'bar ba lta bus/ ji skad du/ sna yi tsha ba mnyos pa'i bu// brkus pa'i nor dang g.yar ba'i rgyan// slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams// yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba nyung*// zhes pa ltar/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungs// zhes pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i gtso bo chos thams cad zab mo rten cing 'brel pa'i tshul khyad du gsod par mi rung bar dgongs gzhi tsam gyis rnam thar dngos gzhir gsal ltar gyi slob dpon du ma bsten pa'i tshul las don du shes bya thams cad rang rdol du ye shes kyi me long gtsang mar 'gog pa med par shar ba zhig ste/ de ltar yang rje 'di nyid kyi mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyi phyag rjes rnams/ rje nyid kyi slob dpon rnams kyis kyang 'gran du med par yod pa 'di bzhin gyis shes nus mod/ rgyu de dag la brten nas bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyis mtshon pa'i sa dbang chen po'i par khang du rgya bod kyi bstan bcos glegs bam sum brgya skor bzhugs pa zhus dag pa so so nas bskyar zhus mang du bgyis pa'i dogs gnas gang byung gi thad nas rje nyid kyi spyan sngar gzigs pa phul ba'i sgo nas zhus dag bskrun par gnang ba'i tshul ni gong rnam thar dngos gzhir gsal ltar la/

'on kyang gzhan la dogs gnas shar ma nus pa'i thad nas phyi mo ltar lus pa 'ga' zhig ni rje nyid kyi gzigs pas ma khyab pa las/ gzhan rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum skor gyis mtshon pa'i spyan lam dang phyag bstar gnang rigs mtha' dag la/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ khyod kyis tshig don 'di la rgyu// tha dad yod ces gang gsungs pa// de la mkhas pa bye bas kyang*// chos dang mthun par brgal mi nus// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshig don gang gi cha la yang the tshom gyi gnas gtan nas med pa 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu 'gran bral du grub pa yin zhing*/ 'on kyang sngon gyi rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar lhur mdzad pas/ rnam thar 'di nyid kyi dbur gzhan ngor skye brgyud 'phros tsam gnang ba 'di dag ma gtogs gzhan ni dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyis/ bdag gi nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing*// gzhan gyi 'khrul pa btsal mi bya// bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing*// gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya// zhes dang*/ khro dang nga rgyal gzhom bya zhing*// dman pa'i sems dang ldan par bya// zhes pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin gyis/ rje nyid mkhas pa dang dam par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal sogs gtan nas mi mdzad par gzhan rig gnas phyogs re tsam shes pa'am/ legs bshad tshigs bcad gcig 'byin pa la'ang dpyod ldan du bsngags pa'i gzhan gyi yon tan sgrogs pa kho na lhur len pa/ gzhan gyis the tshom gyi 'ching ba phra rags gang zhig gi dogs gcod zhus kyang rang rang gi dogs gnas dngos dang*/ der ma zad gzhan sems mkhyen pa'i mngon shes ltar de dag ma shes na 'di yang mi shes gsungs pa'i slar yang dogs slong mtha' dpyad kyis gsung gi bdud rtsi lan cig myangs pa'i skal bzang gang gis kyang yid ches bslu med du rnyed pa/ de dag kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' lung dgongs don dang 'brel nges pa'i gtan tshigs dang bcas pa ma gtogs par rje nyid bstan pa'i dag byed chen por gyur pas gang gsungs tshad mar bzung bar nges phyir mi chos bla ma'i rdzun lta bur song gis dogs pas phra zhing phra ba nas gtan la 'bebs par mdzad cing*/

sngar phan gsan dgongs ma nges pa lta bu phran bu'i tshul la de nga'i mi shes gsungs pa ma gtogs blun po mgo skor gyi 'ol tshod lta bu nam du yang mi mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis sangs rgyas la bstod par/ mtho la phrag dog mi mdzad cing*// dma' la rngan can mi mdzad la// mnyam la 'gran pa mi mnga' bas// khyod ni 'jig rten gtso bor gyur// zhes sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos su gsungs pa yang rje 'di nyid la nges par mnga' ba yin te/ ji ltar skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la yang legs pa'i skar ma dang kun tu rgyu rnams kyis log par blta ba lta bu ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ blun pos blun po mthong gyur na// tsan+dan las kyang bsil bar sems// blun pos mkhas pa mthong gyur na// pha gsod pa ni lta bu sems// zhes pa ltar/ rje 'di nyid kyi mkhyen rab mtha' yas pa dag la 'gran du ni mi bzod kyang blun po rang nyid mkhas pa'i grags par re ba dag me khyer srin 'bu'i snang ba/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi bag la zha ba ltar gyur pa ma bzod pa'i sgro skur 'debs pa dag rgya lam byung yang dam pa'i chos kyi gsung drang pos gdul bar 'os pa la ni de ltar mdzad kyis/ gzhan du ji mi snyam par bzhag pa las gang zag phal pa lta bus nga bden kho rdzun gyi thugs 'khrugs pa gtan nas mi mnga' dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rigs gang zhig gnang yang yig cha gang yin pa de'i tshig zur tsam yang ma nyams pa dper na dbu gsum phyag drug ces pa dang*/ zhal gsum phyag drug lta bu/ pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhes pa dang*/ pad nyi'i gdan la lta bu/ sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ sbrul dang mgo phreng zhes pa lta bu rnams don 'dra ba tsam gyi hol spyod mi mdzad par de nyid yang bskyar gyis cho ga'i rgyun dang dam pa'i phyag bzhes mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma nyams pa bstan pa thugs khongs su bcang bar mdzad cing*/

gzhan mtshams sbyor gyi rigs dang*/ khrid rim gyi spros bshad sogs gzhan nas rgyas 'gebs dgos rigs dngos shugs nas bstan pa dang*/ yig cha snga ma dbang po rab la dgongs pa'i bsdus don lta bu las med pa rnams la rgyas spros gnang rigs kyang mdo rgyud gang yin pa de dang phyogs mthun zhing cho ga'i chings gcig pa so so nas ma 'dres pa ma gtogs zhwa dpe l+h+wam 'gebs kyis thugs gsal gsal dang*/ 'chad bde bde lta bu'i gya ma tho gtan nas mi mdzad/ gang 'chad bya de dag gi bod skad dang legs sbyar gang yang slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos/ gang gis 'byung gnas mi shes pas// log par smra ba du ma mthong*// de phyir dag par brjod shes phyir// yi ge'i 'byung gnas brjod thabs bshad// ces pa nas/ 'a ha a yi yi ge gsum// khog pa mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'byung*// ka kha ga yi yi ge gsum// rkan phug lce rtsa'i cha las 'byung*// ya zha ca cha ja nya sha /bdun po lce dkyil rkan dbus las// ta tha da na ra la drug /lce rtse rkan mtha' rnyil las 'byung*// tsa tsha dza za sa lnga po// lce rtse so las 'byung ba'o// pa pha ba ma wa dang lnga// mchu las rab tu 'byung ba yin// nga nya na ma'i yi ge bzhi// rang rang gnas dang sna las 'byung*// zhes sogs nas/ gang dang gang la gang btags pa// go rim bzhin du gnas nas dbyung*// de la ra mgo lce rtse 'dar// la mgo lce klod rgya yangs bskyed// sa mgo so yi bar nas dbyung*// lhag pa rnams kyang de bzhin shes// gal te mi phyin gyur pa ni// yi ge phral zhing brjod par bya// dper na gra la ga ra'am// sgra la sga ra ji bzhin du// de nas 'phul ba bslab par bya// gas 'phul thog mar rkan nas dbyung*// das 'phul lce rtse klod pa las// ba mas 'phul la thog mar ni// mchu btsums pa las khyad par sna// 'as 'phul gre ba'i phug nas dbyung*// 'phul zhing brtsegs pa'i yi ge yang*// go rim bzhin dbyung ma phyed na// 'di yang phral zhing bklag pa ste// mkhra la mkha' ra ji bzhin no// zhes dang*/

brtsegs sam 'bul lam 'phul zhing brtsegs// tsheg par gcig na yi ge'i grangs// du yod de dag thams cad kyis// gug skyed mnyam por 'thob pa yin// dper na sgru la sgu ru'am// sbre la sbe re ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' dag gis bod yul gyi rang bzhin gyi skad dag par gdon shes pa'i ched du yi ge rkyang 'phul brtsegs 'dogs mtha' rten gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa bzhin bklags na/ yi ge'i sbyor ba mdzad mkhan rgyal blon de dag spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ phan yon la dgongs nas bod yig kyang sgra zur shin tu phyin par nan tan dang*/ legs sbyar kyang 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar grags pa brda' sprod pa'i lugs kyis dbyangs ring thung ming gi gcod mtshams so sor gnang ba las ljags klog byang ba tsam kho na rgyu mtshan gyi lab lob gtan nas mi mdzad/ rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes nar ma yang 'od gsal 'khor yug mnyam rjes dbyer med kyi ngang nas ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas bzung*/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i srung ba thun mong thun min/ kye rdo rje'i lam dus nyin zhag re la thun gnyis gsum gang rigs nam mkha' zas su za ba'i gdams pa bcas/ mkha' spyod/ 'jigs byed/ ku ru kul+le/ mgon dkar/ grub thob tshe sgrub/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpal dkar dmar/ dbyangs can dmar mo/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon/ 'byung 'dul/ gtum po khyung lnga/ seng gdong sngon mo/ seng ge sgra/ khyung khra/ khyung dmar/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ skabs gseng rnams su/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ ltung bshags/ gong ma lnga sogs sku bstod rigs/ smon lam rnam gsum sogs dang dgongs mo gtor bsngos kyi rigs sogs bskyed rdzogs chu bo'i rgyun gyi nyams bzhes 'khor mo yug tu gnang yang*/

gzhan tho yig sogs mi 'dug pas rags rim de tsam las zhib bkod rngo ma thog cing*/ thugs dam zhal 'don gyi sgang du yang chos 'dod don gnyer rigs sku mdun du sleb tshe da lan thugs mi skabs sogs gtan nas mi gsung bar thog mar snyan par smra ba'i gdangs kyis khyed ci la byon zhes sngon du 'gro bas chos kyi sbyin pa gtso bor gyur pas mchog dman kun gyi re ba'i shing rta rgyas par 'gengs pa de lta bus thugs dam shol che dus mtshan gang la zhal 'don mi grub pa 'byung yang bstan pa dang sems can thugs blos ma thongs pas dgyes tshor ma gtogs thugs sun gyi rnam pa nam yang mi gnang ba de lta bu'i bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya mchog dman grangs med pa chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i tshul rags rim gong rnam thar dngos gzhi'i skabs song bzhin/ da dung rje 'di nyid kyi che ba'i yon tan su zhig gi thos 'dzin bcud du lhung ba de dag zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal zhing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bar rings pa ni dri ldan me tog gi tshal la bung ba 'du ba lta bus sa dge rnying ma dkar 'brug sogs kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i mkhas btsun bzang dgu'i zhal slob du ma dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag kyang de mtshungs bcas mdor na 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rje btsun rin po che la bstod par/ yi ge 'dod la yi ge dang*// rtsis pa rnams la rtsis dang ni// 'tsho byed rnams la 'tsho byed gzhung*// chos 'dod rnams la chos kyang ston// gang gis phan dgongs thugs rje yis// nye bar phan la de ston pas// ston mchog khyod 'dra ma mchis te// zhes 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyis rjes su 'dzin pa la ston pa mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang gnyis su ma mchis par bsngags pa de rje 'di nyid kyi tshul dang thun mong du gyur pa ste/ de yang*/ thog mar ji ltar gsan pa'i rkang grangs tsam ni gong rnam thar dngos gzhi'i skabs dang*/

zhib par rje nyid kyi gsan yig don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter glegs bam gnyis su gsal ba ltar gyis gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son/ de dag las gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid gzhung dngos ni/ dam pa chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus gtsang dag zhing gi chos sde spyi dang*/ khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bzhed gzhung ni mkha' spyod 'og min gnyis pa dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs stegs pad+ma rā ga'i me long gtsang mar sa gsum dregs ldan yongs kyi bzhin ras 'char ba ga la bar mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gyi zhabs sen rnam par bkod pa'i mkhan brgyud thams cad gzigs pa na rim las gzhan dag gis 'chad srol med pa ma gtogs/ gzhan dag gang gsan pa de rnams las dbang khrid ljags lung phal che ba ni tshar grangs du ma dang*/ tha na'ang gang gsan pa las tshar re ma 'chad pa med pa lta bus bstan pa'i srog mthud par gnang zhing*/ gsan don de dag kyang bsam byung gi shes rab sgrib thogs med pas nem nur gyi 'ching ba grol zhing*/ ji bzhin gsan don thugs nyams su bzhes pas gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa phyin gyi ma log par thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pas ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum las// 'chad rtsod dag la ma nges pa// 'byung srid mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsung rab rgya che ba rnams snying po lag len du dril ba dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig don zab cing brling ba'i rtsa ba nyung ngu rnams rgya cher bkral ba dang*/ rigs mthun gyi cho ga spyi 'gred dgongs pa las dang po pas lag tu mi lon pa'i ma tshang ba'i rigs lta bu kha 'gengs pa dang*/ gsang sngags rang dgar spyod pa'i nyes pa 'gog byed kyi gab 'khrugs kyi rigs chos srung las bka' rgya bkrol te dkyus su bsdebs pa sogs brtsams pa'i bstan bcos de dag kyang*/

ji skad du/ don med don log don dang ldan// ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong*// thos rtsod bsgrub pa lhur len pa'i// bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod// ces pa'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid dgu las/ dang po gnyis gnyis kyi drug ni thar pa don gnyer dag gis blang bya ma yin pas bral ba ste dor la/ tha ma'i re re ni blang bar bya ba ste don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos/ sdug bsngal spong byed kyi bstan bcos bsgrub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos gsum po gtso bor bton pa'i bka' rtsom gyi rim pa yang gsan yig glegs bam gnyis dang*/ bstan 'gyur rin po che'i dkar chag glegs bam gcig bcas khyon glegs bam bcu gcig bzhugs pa'i chos tshan gyi rnam grangs tsam brjod pa skabs su bab kyang yi ge mangs kyi dogs pas ma spros pas don du gnyer ba dag gis bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag gzigs pas gsal zhing bka' 'bum dngos gzhi thos bsam mdzad mkhan la ni smos ma dgos pa de lta bu'i bstan bcos de dag kyang tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing khyad par tshigs bcad gang gnang yang rgyan gyi lam du 'dren pa'i ched gnang gang yang mi dogs par rang shugs kyis snyan ngag nyid du 'char bas sngon rabs ljongs 'di'i snyan ngag mkhan chen por grags pa rnams kyang zil gyis gnon pa mngon sum 'di lta bu la yang dka' ba cung zad med cing don gyi cha la dpyad pa gsum gyis nongs pa med pas mkhas pa rnams mgu ba skyed pa/ lag len dper brjod dang bcas pas gsal bar bstan cing myong ba rgyus thogs nas gsungs pas the tshom gyi gnas med cing blo mchog dman thams cad kyi mig lta bur gyur pa'i tshul 'di lta bu'i bstan pa la sku drin che ba ni dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i srid pa gsum gyi stobs ldan dag gis phyag bya ba'i yul mchog tu gyur cing*/ rgyal ba rnams kyang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dbyings nas ston par nges te/

'jam mgon chos rjes/ khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge sgra// lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gtso// lto 'phye'i dbang pos nyer bstan cing*// rgyal ba yis kyang mthun par bsngags// zhes gsungs pa'i bsngags yul dang rje 'di nyid kyi gsung rab la ya mtshan tha dad med pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar gyi cha shas re re nas brtag cing gzhig na sku tshe ril por gsan sbyangs kho na byas pa min nam snyam pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'chad pa dang*/ brtsam pa dang*/ bstan pa'i byi dor sogs phyogs re la bsgril ba min nam snyam pa 'di lta bu ni/ mkhas pa chen po'i gsungs las/ skad cig bskal pa bskal pa skad cig tu// bsgyur nus 'gro re'i snang ngor mdzad pa re// ston la mkhas grub phal gyi rnam thar bzhin// lo zla dus kyi nges 'tshol bzhad gad gnas// zhes gsungs pa ni 'phags chen 'di lta bu'i rigs kyi mdzad pa la dgongs pa ste tshur mthong skye bo'i rtog brtag gi yul las brgal ba nyid do// gzhan yang skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid kyi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshul la sems cung zad re 'phros kyang*/ dad pa'i ba spu dbang med du g.yo ba'i tshul rang shugs bzlog tu ma btub par 'phros tsam brjod pa yin la/ deng dus skyabs mgon 'di nyid zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal bzang rnams ni rang sems dpang por gnas pas da dung yon tan 'di dang 'di lta bu yod kyang 'dir 'phros ma byung 'dug snyam pa las brjod thal ba'i skyon du mi sems pa ni mngon gyur nyid kyang*/ kho bo blo gros kyi mig dkyus thung zhing brjod du ma 'tshal ba dang*/ gzhan dag tshig tshogs nyung ba la don gnyer che bas spros pa ma byas mod/ cung zad brjod pa 'di ni slad kyi gang zag gang yang rung ba ma dad pa rnams dad pa bskyed cing*/

dad pa rnams slar yang yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pas rgyal sras 'di lta bu'i rnam thar gyi rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa skyed pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog tu sbyor ba'i dgos pa khyad par can gyi dbang gis yin zhing*/ 'on kyang 'di tsam brjod pa yang 'phags chen gzhan gyi rnam thar rgyas 'gebs lta bus brjod 'dod dang sgro btags sogs las/ deng sang dus dbang snyigs ma'i skabs 'dir mdo rgyud dri ma med pa'i lung dang mthun pa'i skyes chen de lta bu zhig nges par byon zin nam snyam pa'i log rtog byung srid na/ de ni dus dbang sogs mtha' gcig tu mi btsan te/ rgyal sras dam pa rnams ni yul dus gang zag sogs shin tu ma rungs shing gdul dka' ba dag la thugs rje lhag par 'jug pa ste mgon po shān+ta de bas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi dga' bas// pad+ma'i mtsho ru ngang pa ltar// mnar med par yang 'jug par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dharma rak+ṣi ta chen pos/ bde skyid dpal gyi ldum ra mdzes gyur kyang*// dpa' bo dag ni chags par mi 'gyur gyis// sdug bsngal nags su sems dpa' 'tsho ba yin// de phyir bde skyid dang du len pa yi// sdar ma'i dbang gis sdug la skyel ba yin// sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i sems dpa' de// dpa' bo'i stobs kyis rtag tu bde ba yin// zhes dang*/ de phyir sems dpa' rma bya lta bu yis// dug gi nags dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs rnams// bcud du bsgyur la 'khor ba'i gnas su 'jug /dang du blangs la dug 'di gzhom par bya// zhes rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa'i tshul mtha' yas pa dag thos nas yid ches par bya dgos shing*/ gzhan dag khyod rang gis gnyen dang bshes su gyur pas bsngags pa brjod pa'am/ khyod nyid la tshe 'dir zas nor tsam gyis drin du gyur pa gzo ba'i phyir 'di ltar bsngags pa min nam snyam na/

de lta bu zhig na bdag nyid phyogs su lhung ba'i nyes par 'gyur shing*/ dam pa ma yin pa la dam par brjod pa'i mi chos bla ma'i rdzun du yang 'gyur bas ci'i phyir brjod de gnyen la chags pa'i phyogs su lhung ba'i bsngags pa brjod pa'i sgro skur dang*/ dgra la sdang ba'i phyogs su lhung ba'i smad pa'i sgro skur dag nyes par mtshungs te/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes pa ltar gyi nyes pa sel ba'i phyir slob dpon bde byed bdag pos sangs rgyas la bstod par/ bcom ldan de ni bdag gi gnyen min mu stegs gzhan dag dgra ma yin// de dag gi spyod gzhan yang mngon sum gyur par ma mthong ste// tshig dang spyod pa dag gis so so'i khyad par thos pa las// sangs rgyas yon tan phul du phyin la dad phyir bdag rten lags// zhes dang*/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ gal te phyogs su lhung gyur na// bstod par gyur kyang smad pa'i gnas// zhes dang*/ rje btsun rin po ches/ gnyen gyi 'brel bas khyed la dad min te// nges par sangs rgyas yin pa'i nges shes kyis// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul 'di dag gi spang blang tshul bzhin gyi sgo nas bla ma la sgro skur med par bsngags pa ni gong du smos pa'i dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang phan yon tshad med pa yod de/ rgyud las/ lha sku bye ba stong bsgoms pas// bla ma dran pa bsod nams che// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bsnyen bkur ba pas ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa'i bsod nams ches khyad par 'phags so// zhes sogs phan yon brjod kyis mi lang bas yid drangs te cung zad gleng bar byas pa'o// de ltar gang gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi tshul mtha' dag bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan gyi phung po nyes pa'i dri ma gzhar yang mi mnga' zhing nges par mi las 'das pa'i 'phags chen dam pa de nyid ni/

ji ltar/ mkhyen pas srid la mi gnas kyang*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// zhes pa ltar/ thugs rje chen po rgyun mi chad pas gzugs kyi skur snang bas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i mthar/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa las/ las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las// grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang*// ji ltar pad+mo chus mi chag pa bzhin// nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad// ces pa dang*/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed// rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston// zhes dang*/ rje 'di nyid kyis mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub kyi rnam thar du/ gang gi rang bzhin 'chi 'pho med pa'i rdo rje gsum ni brnyes gyur kyang*// rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo can rnams la 'dus mtha' 'bral dang 'tsho mtha' yang*// 'chi ba nyid las 'das pa min zhes gdams pa'i phrin yig bden dpang du// brgya phrag bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku yang mi rtag bstan// zhes pa ltar/ nges pa'i don du ring mo'i dus zhig nas/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba thams cad ni grol/ srid pa'i gcong rong nyam nga ba nas ni thon/ 'chi bdag la sogs pa'i bdud bzhi'i g.yul las ni rgyal/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer bsil bar ni phyin/ zag zad kyi ye shes dam pa ni mngon du mdzad pa zhig ni gor ma chag pa gang gi rnam thar la rjes su dpag pas shes shing*/ de lta bu la 'ching ba kun ldan gyi gang zag lta bus skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal rang rgyud pa nyams su myong ba med kyang*/ sprul pa'i gzugs kyi sku ni sems can thams cad la mngon sum snang ba'i phyir 'dus byas su grub cing*/ 'dus byas yin na mi rtag pa nyid chos kyi sdoms su nges phyir/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i nyer bsdogs su gzhol ba'i tshul sarga lnga pa de 'phros/

zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin snga gro nged ser skya la smon lam bton bcug pa sogs grub rjes gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi glegs bam las 'da' ka ma'i 'pho ba'i skor la gzigs rtogs phan tsam gnang*/ de ring tshes bco lnga yin nam zhes bka' 'dri stsal/ snga sor zhabs 'bring der 'khod bdag sogs rnams kyis sku nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs gtad gnang na/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du yang srid zhig phebs tshe dmigs bsal can zung la yong ba zhus par/ de bzhin rgyu rkyen rten 'brel phun tshogs 'dzom dgos don 'di zhes dkrigs chod bya rgyu ci yod kyang gnas mchog skal ba gang yod zhig la smon lam bgyid gsungs snga gang tshes brgyad la phrin bcol gsar rtsom mdzad grub pa dang*/ de nyin yang sku zhabs mkhan rin po cher nga rang gi 'phral dar kha phul nas/ nged kyi skye ba gong ma la bstan phan byung lugs/ da lta'i skye ba 'dir kun gyis gsal ltar dang*/ ma 'ongs par yang bstan pa la phan thogs can gyi sprul sku zhig yong ba'i blo gtad phrin bcol bgyis yod pas/ sprul sku myur 'byon mdzad gnang zhus/ sa skya gong ma rin po cher yang nga rang shi 'phral sngar gyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rgyu mtshan skor la gzigs pas khyab dgos tshul zhu yig zhib pa rten mtshon mgyogs chas lta bu'i dar kha dang*/ gser srang gang bcas gdan sa'i mdo 'gron yar 'khor gyi rjes zin nges byed nas bskur dgos tshul phebs/ de nyin thugs rab shin tu gsal che zhing*/ da lta bya ba las 'phro ci med dam zhes bka' yang yang phebs/ nged rnams kyis kyang ci yang med tshul zhus/ dgongs ka'i dus tsam kho bo'i spyi bo na bla ma 'od dpag med bzhugs 'dug ces dang*/ 'phur song ces dang*/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas a mtshar po zhes sogs yang yang stsal/ rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes rnams chag 'khri gtan nas med khar/

lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di tshar grangs shin tu mang bar gsungs/ lar dus rgyun gtor bsngo dang thugs dam rnams kyi skabs su sa ngor bstan pa rgyas pa dang sde dge lcam dral sras lcam sogs sku ngo rnams dang*/ dbon ye shes rgya mtsho sogs mdun 'khor drag rim bstan jus la phan pa rnams kyi sku tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ bzhed don 'grub pa'i phrin bcol sogs rgyun du gnang srol yod 'dug pas 'di skabs kyang mdzad song*/ de nub dgongs mo nas rdo rje bsdu ba dang ye shes pa dgug pa'i phyag rgya lta bu sna tshogs phyag dal med mtshan gong du mdzad nas/ gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs stag gi dus tsam la sku tshe 'di'i 'gro don rdzogs nas dag pa'i zhing gshegs rgyu'i/ sku drang po/ zhabs skyil krung*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol nas rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ thun mong gi snang ngor phyi rol zhal rlung gi 'gro 'ong rgyun chad de nang du rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pa'i skabs der rlung dang byang chub kyi sems thams cad dbu mar zhugs te/ rlung gi nus pas stong gsal mchog gi ting 'dzin skye la/ sngar zab mo'i lam la goms pa'i stobs kyis gzhi la gnas pa'i 'od gsal ma dang*/ bsgom stobs kyis myong ba'i 'od gsal bu gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ don gyi 'od gsal chos kyi sku rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa mngon du gyur pa de nyid kyi ngang las g.yo ba med par zhag gsum gyi bar bzhugs pa'i de'i tshe zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dwangs shing 'dzum nyams dang bcas te lus can mtha' dag dad pa'i sa bon gsos su thebs par mdzad do// de ltar yang*/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ slob dpon mthar byed dus su ni// 'jig rten pa rnams shi zhes sgrogs// mi ldan mi rnams gang zer ba// shi zhes pa de 'dir rmongs pa'o// shi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// dag pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa'o// zhes sogs rgyud sde'i lung du ma dang*/

de'i dus su sku gdung chas su 'jug lugs kyang*/ lag par rdo rje dril bu byin// mgo bor dbu rgyan bskon par bya// zhes gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la dgongs shing 'dir rje bla ma 'di nyid phyi so thar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog tu bzhugs kyang*/ nang rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor zag med bde stong gi ngang du 'byams pas don gyi cha nas longs sku'i chas su 'jug 'os kyang*/ rje nyid sku phreng rjes ma la rab byung gi rten can lta bu'i rten 'brel gyi dgongs gzhi yin nam snyam pas dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i de 'phral nyid nas bla ma kun dga' bsod chen pa sogs der yod rnams kyis zhal chems ltar snam sbyar dang*/ dbu zhwa gsol te/ mchod pa'i yo byad kyang ci 'byor pa tshar du dngar ba bgyis so// de tshe gzims chung steng du 'ja' 'od zug pa dgon pa'i grwa pa mang pos nges par mthong zhing*/ phyi nyin nas nyin ltar kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' 'od kyi bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi gzugs dbyibs 'dra bas phyogs kun khyab pa kun gyis mthong bar byung ngo*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i go 'phang nyid// ring mo zhig nas mngon du mdzad pa gang*// rang bzhin dbugs kyi rgyu ba'i rgyun re yang*// gzhan don mi 'gyur med pa rgyal rnams gshis// gang tshe 'tsho gzhes bstan 'gro'i phan bde bsgrubs// zhi bar gshegs pas mi rtag rgyud bskul ston// tha ma'i gsung gis bdag sogs mos gus spel// bslu med skyabs kyi nges pa da gdod rnyed// rnam 'dren gang gis zhing 'dir sku dngos kyis// bstan 'gror sman pa'i phrin las dkar po'i cha// yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon phyir 'phel phyogs kyi// rdzogs gsum mtshan mo'i thun mthar 'od gsal mnal// stong pa'i mkha' las rang byung glog ldan ma// slar yang 'chi med lam du yal ba des// smon lam dag pa'i gdul bya'i ngor snang ba'i// gzugs sku chos dbyings thim pa'i tshul 'di ston// lhan skyes bde ba'i rang bzhin ye shes sku// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bdar te// bgrang yas ḍā ki'i tshogs dpon spyan drangs pa// nyin bzhin 'ja' tshon drwa ba gtibs 'dis rtogs// de tshe dkar po'i phyogs kyi mi min rnams// rang gi legs byas skyed tshal las btus pa'i// me tog sil ma char du bsnyil ba yis// phal dang dam pa'i khyad par ston pa bzhin// 'dren pa khyod kyis bstan la legs mdzad kyis// phyogs dus rgyal kun dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar mdangs// sna tshogs mchod pa'i yo byad rnam pa'i sprin// zla shel kun+da'i dpal 'phrog bar med gtibs// mi snang grub pa'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ngo mtshar mdzad pas yid 'phrog dga' ba dang*// bdag sogs rjes 'jug rnams kyis dngos mjal gyi// skal ba zad pa'i mya ngan lhan cig rgyas// gang la nye dang ring ba'i phyogs lhung med// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i re ba skong*// so sos bdag gi bsod nams dpal snyam pa'i// dpag bsam shing zhig ma la deng 'dir 'gyel// dung dung bzod med dad pa'i bu slob tshogs// bsil bsil snying khung grang ba'i nyam thag gi

/lhang lhang thugs rjes 'dzin par gsol 'debs na// gsal gsal ye shes snyan gyis mi gsan nam// 'on te zab chos thugs kyi nying khu bstsal// rang rig don gyi bla mar ngo yang sprad// skye bar rjes su 'dzin par zhal bzhes pas// thugs rje rgyun 'chad med snyam ngal bso thob// ces pa ste/ tshes bco brgyad kyi tho rengs sngar gyi gshegs tshod la sa g.yo ba lta bu'i sgra shin tu che ba zhig kun gyis thos pa byung bas/ bla ma kun dga' bsod nams dang lhun grub phun tshogs gnyis gdung mdun du phyin pas/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang bzhugs stangs sogs las grol te/ sku rgyab phyogs su dgye zhing zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi rnam pa dang*/ shangs bug gnyis las byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun mang bar phebs pa ni rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rnal 'byor mchog gi lam rtags khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ bde mchog las/ chos kyi sku la chos skur ngo shes pa 'chi kha nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas rnam shes spyi gtsug nas song ste/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams su 'gro bar 'gyur ro// de'i rtags ni pha'i khu ba'i thig le sna bug g.yon nas mar 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de nub ngos kyi rmi lam du rje nyid rgyun gyi bzhugs gnas de ka nas khyed rnams nga 'chi song ma bsam dang*/ nga rang me tog pad+ma zhig gi steng du 'od dpag med kye rdo rje dang dbyer med du gyur song zhes bka' bstsal pa rmis/ de nyin sku zhabs mkhan chen phebs nas smon lam sogs gnang*/ phyag mdzod bla ma shes rab bzang pos phebs nas dar sna lnga'i snyan shal dang brgya mchod bcas phul ba mdzad/ 'di skabs nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' sprin dang me tog gi char pa ngo mtshar ba yang byung ngo*// de skabs shig phyag mdzod kyi mtshan lam du phan gling g.yab chen la khri mtho ba zhig la rje 'di nyid dang*/

de las cung dma' ba zhig la shar pa mkhan chen bzhugs par/ rje 'dis mkhan chen la tshe dbang zhig 'bul zhing*/ khong rang la dar kha zhig gnang ba'i mnal ltas byung 'dug pa yang dpon slob dam tshig sel med kyis dag pa ye shes kyi skus sku zhabs kyi bar gcod sogs sel ba'i rtags su nges shing*/ de mtshams chas gzhug kyang snga ma bzhin dang*/ lung phran tshegs las/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'das pa'i 'og tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la bdag cag gis mchod pa ji snyed cig brtson par bgyi lags/ kun dga' bo khyod snying nas chung ngur gyis shig 'di ni bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag bsgrub par 'gyur ro// btsun pa bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyid lags/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la bya ba bzhin du byed do// btsun pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la ji ltar bgyid lags/ kun dga' bo 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni lus shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkris zhing*/ shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkris nas ras zung lnga brgyas g.yogs par bya'o// zhes dang*/ rgyud las mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma 'das pa'i tshe// gdung ba'i sems kyis mchi ma byung gyur na// phra rab rdul dang mnyam pa'i grangs snyed kyis// bskal par bsags pa'i sdig chen byang gyur te// ma 'ongs dus su zhabs drung skye bar 'gyur// gdan khri legs bshams steng du pur bzhag nas// chu gtsang argas sku khrus legs gsol na// bskal pa bye bar bsags pa'i sdig byang nas// zag med chos sku dri bral thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ chos rje kun dga' bsam gtan/ dbu mdzad kun dga' bsod nams/ shākya chos 'phel/ lhun grub phun tshogs/ ngag dbang dpal bzang rnams kyi dri bzang gis chus sku khrus gsol te/

bzang drug rigs sna tshogs su btsos pa'i ka shi ka'i ras bzang po'i na bza' gsol nas sngar gyi gnas su bzhugs su gsol lo// de skabs rnams su yang sngar gyi mchod 'bul rnams kyi khar/ ji skad du/ bla ma 'das pa'i lo zla tshes grangs dag /nges par bzung ste mchod pa byas gyur na// bskal pa bye bar bsags pa'i sdig bcom nas// shin tu mi bzad gshin rje'i grong las thar// zhes dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo 'phan la sogs// dung dang rnga chen rol mo sogs kyis mchod// mchod pa bcu dang bkra shis tshig bsgrags la// bskal pa ther 'bum bsags pa'i las dag nas// zag med chos sku thob nas gzugs sku yi// snang ba skyes nas srid gsum sdug bsngal sgrol// zhes sogs dang*/ ye shes dam pa'i rgyud las/ bskal pa'i sangs rgyas mchod pa bas// bla ma'i ba spu'i nyag gcig la// 'bru mar thigs pa gcig blugs na// bsod nams phung po khyad par 'phags// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rang nas mchod pa ci 'byor dang*/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pas brgya mchod/ gzhan yang lhun grub steng gi grwa rigs so so'i me tog spos/ mar me sogs mchod pa'i sprin che bas mdun bdar nas dgon sde byings dmangs kun la mjal kha btang ba dang*/ de dag rnams kyis snyan shal dang*/ yan lag bdun pa'i phyag mchod 'bul ba rnams bsgrub bo// de nas kyang sngar gyi lung gi 'phros/ ras zung lnga brgyas g.yogs te lcags kyi sgrom du bcug nas 'bru mar gyi bkang ste/ steng nas lcags kyi kha gab pa gnyis kyis bkab nas dri zhim po'i shing thams cad spungs te/ des bsregs nas me de dag 'o mas bsad do// zhes sogs mdo las kyang sku gdung bsregs par gsungs pa cha mthun tsam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rgyud sde'i dgongs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi de nyid dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la sbyin sreg gi cho gas mchod pa'i tshul gsungs pa bzhin/

tshes nyer gcig gi phyi dro sku gdung rin po che pur khang du gdan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ lhun grub steng gi dge 'dun bcu re res mos kyi kye rdor sgrub mchod gsol dgung ma rdzogs par btang rgyu'i de dgongs sta gon tshugs pa byas/ sku gdung zhun du 'bul gang tshun la nged rang der yod kun gyis nyin ltar yan lag bdun pa'i gdung mchod phyag 'bul gsol gdab rigs ci 'grub bgyis/ tshes nyer gnyis la sku zhabs mkhan rin po ches sku gdung zhugs su 'bul rgyu'i gra bsgrigs bgyis par/ 'di skabs grwa slob rnams kyis kyang 'phral snang sku gshegs rkyen chab bsags kyi rnam pas me bzhes cung dka' ba'i gleng mo dang dogs gzhi'i bud shing kyang mang ba bsags/ de skor gyi rgyu mtshan mkhan rin po che'i snyan dbang du gsan pa'i thugs dogs la brten nas tshes nyer gnyis kyi nam dkar 'phral nas phebs te kye rdor dus tha'i cho ga la brten pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas nyi shar 'brug dus zhugs su phul ba mdzad song bas/ sngar gyi rtsig shing phran tsam dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi yam shing ma gtogs gsar du bud shing rigs gtan nas sabs ma dgos par sku gdung rang las ye shes kyi me rang 'bar lta bus me lce che bas/ nyi dros sbrul gyi mjug tsam nas lhag med du zhu grub pas thams cad sngar gyi dogs gnas la dpag pa'i ya mtshan gyis dad spro gang 'phel mngon gyur byung*/ chos rje kun dga' bsam gtan pas kyang kun rig la brten pa'i zhugs 'bul cho ga btang*/ 'di nyin snga dro nam mkha' shin tu g.ya' dag cing gsal ba dang*/ phyi gro gzha' sprin sna tshogs dang char zim 'bab pa bcas byung ngo*// de ltar su zhig gsol ba btab tsam gyis// mi mthun rgud pa'i gdung ba ring bcil nas// legs dgu'i yon tan 'bad med ster mdzad pa'i// sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs pad du// rang dang gzhan gyi dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis// mchod sprin srid mtha' khyab par mdun bdar te// phyag mchod smon 'debs la sogs lhur blangs thogs// chas zhugs mdo rgyud dgongs pa ji bzhin bgyis// ngur smrig 'chang ba'i 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde// li khri'i chu gter g.yo ba'i ngang tshul dang*// rgyal khams so skye kun la mjal phyag sgo// yangs por phye ba'i skal bzang ci yang stsal// rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde che// dpal ldan dges pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang*// mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon dbyer med blos// gzhan don ring bsrel sgrub pa'i cho ga brtsams// gsal bar byas so byin za'i dud pa yis// lha yi rdzings ring phyogs kyi khor yug kun// bai ḍū'i mdog las ches cher dwangs pa dang*// sna tshogs dbang gzhu ngo mtshar ri mo yang*// tshes nyer lnga la lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba chen por 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs chen gyis dpal dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub mchod nyin bzhi par btsugs/

zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i rgyud la brten pa'i grwa pa drug cus rus sbyangs kyi cho ga bgyis nas/ rim gyis bla ma kun dga' bsod chen pa sogs kyis gdung rus zhib pa btul/ tshes bcu bdun la gdung tshwa dang sāts+tsha btab/ gdung tshwa rnams la gser dngul dang*/ sāts+tsha rnams la tshon rtsi gsol ba grub nas/ tshes nyer lnga nyin gdung thal sāts+tsha bzhugs gnas rdo kho mar mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gi lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi nye 'khris su/ dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams gtsor bzhugs kyis khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i skar 'dzin thig 'debs byas par de nub nam gung yol tsam la sa g.yos shig byung ba dang*/ tshes nyer bdun nyin chos rje rong po bla ma dbu bzhugs dge 'dun brgyad cus gdung tshwa dang*/ sāts+tsha rnams la rus chog bstar ba'i mun rub tsam la sa g.yos byung zhing*/ nyer brgyad nub ngos kyi rmi lam du lhun grub steng mgon khang lta bu zhig tu bdag slebs pas/ shar nub kyi mgon bla gnyis po 'dra ba zhig gis skyabs mgon dam pa'i yang srid kha sang nyer lnga'i sa g.yos dus lhums su zhugs song yang rten 'brel ma 'grigs tshul sogs zer mkhan zhig byung ba dang*/ nye gnas lhun grub phun tshogs la yang snga phyir yang srid kyi brda rtags rmi lam kha shas byung 'dug pa/ sngar sku gshegs khar nges par zhing khams gzhan du gzigs tshe sprul pa'i yang srid cig bstan pa dang sems can la dgongs pa'i yab yum 'di lta bu la phebs dgos zhus song bas/ de tsam rang dbang gyur pa dka' yang gegs sel bsags sbyong phrin bcol 'di bzhin bgyis tshe dam tshig la sel med pas yong las che zhes zhal bzhes phebs kyang*/ zhu ba po nas yal yol ngang du bka' gnang 'phral bsgrub ma byung bas bar gcod kyi dbang btsan par gyur pa bstan 'gro bsod nams dman pa'i rang bzhin du khums mo// 'on te skye 'chi rang dbang gyur pa 'phags chen dam pa'i ngang tshul ni rnam thar 'di kho na'i che ba yang brjod las 'das pa nyid do// de rgyab zhag kha shas song dus lhun grub phun tshogs kyi rmi lam du zer mkhan su yin ma nges pa zhig gis khyod kyi bla ma da lta zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang la bzhugs 'dug zer ba zhig byung ba sku tshe 'dir spyir grub mtha' ris med pa rje nyid kyi gsan yig dang rnam thar dngos kyis gsal ltar kyang*/

thugs kyi snying po rgyal ba e waṃ pa'i ring lugs gtsor bton lta bu gnang yang*/ de dag gi chos phug dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur rnam gnyis sogs rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs bcud du gyur pas brda' rtags de nyid slar yang 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin lta bu zhig tu byon pa min nam snyam mo// dgung tshigs zhe dgu'i ring la nyin ltar gyi sa lam gyi gegs sel bskang gso'i mthar yang srid 'byon pa'i phrin bcol sbyar ba dang*/ khyad par dgung rdzogs tshang ba'i phyi nyin yang rgyab chos lta bur/ rje rang gi gzims chung dang*/ mgon khang yas mar gser khang bcas la dge slong zhe lngas bskang gso dang*/ spyi sger gyi phrin bcol ljags rtsom can bris pa'i snyan shal phul/ gsol kha khang du'ang de mtshungs bgyis/ de mtshams sāts+tsha bzhugs gnas khang brtsegs yang bkod legs grub nas nang rten rigs kyang dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma 'khrul ba'i go rim ltar bgyi/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung*/ gzungs gzhug tu grags pa bla brgyud kyis thog drang mdo rgyud kyi gzungs sngags rigs yongs rdzogs/ rje btsun dam pa rang gi gdung tshwa gdung thal gyi sāts+tsha stong phrag gcig dang brgya lhag pa bcas dbu lo// na bza'/ gzhan yang rten 'dus dang bla ma gong ma'i dam rdzas rigs 'gangs che ba mang po dang*/ bris bsgrubs tshad ldan byas pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ rigs byed ma'i don kun grub pa'i ril bu bcas bzhugs su gsol nas/ dbu mdzad pa de nyid gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun bdun phrag gcig gis rab gnas bcas mthar phyin par byas so// gsol dgung nang la kun dga' blo gsal gyis grwa khang du kho bo cag gtsos dge slong bcu phrag zhig gi kun rig la brten pa'i dgongs rdzogs nyin gang bsgrub/ sa dkar la'ang dge 'dun bcu bdun skor gyi kye rdor sgrub mchod sta gon dngos gzhi nyin gnyis bla mchod bcas btang*/

lhun grub phun tshogs kyi sngar bla mchod bzhag pa gshegs dus kyi tshes bco lnga la bsgyur nas/ dge 'dun bco lnga skor gyis nyin gang btang*/ rgyun gyi nang g.yog a 'phel gyis kyang gsol dgung bdag po bcu phrag la 'phar ja dang du dkar re'i 'gyed phul nas smon lam dge bskul zhus/ rje dam pa de nyid kyi phyag rdzas yod rigs thor bkod nas/ sa dbang chen po lcam dral drung du phul ba/ de zhabs nas par dpon kun dga' chos 'phel can do dam du sku tshab ched bsgos gnang bzhin/ dgongs rdzogs snga phyir btang ba rags rim ni/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog shar pa mkhan chen drung du mdzod btags/ gser zangs kyi sgrol sku/ mchod rten/ sku par/ phyag dril/ gser rtse/ phyag ḍam/ phyag ting*/ phyag phreng rgyan ldan/ rten khebs/ rigs lnga dar dpyang bcas/ gtor cha theb bcas/ li'i bdun tshar/ sbub chal/ thugs dam zhwa mo/ gos rdo rje sa lam gyi rgyan can ring 'gag sham thabs/ pad ma sa lam gyi sku gzan me long ma/ dbus l+h+wam/ chibs sga 'khor tshang*/ rdzab kyi gsol zhal/ li ting*/ skyogs dkar/ lding ga ra/ li sder/ gla gor sder ma/ spen par/ sman yug ling ser sngo ljang gsum yug re/ sngo skya yug gnyis/ la da dkar sngon yug ras yug lnga/ a ti yug 'ga' dkar yug gos rgyan bzhi yug kha thi yug 'jam gos sngo dmar yug re/ ther dril ser po yug phrug snam dkar thig dmar thig ser thig rnams bubs re/ ra 'be yug gnyis/ phying khra/ sbre/ spyang*/ gsa'/ gung*/ g.yi/ gzig rnams kyi pags pa re/ gser srang gang*/ dngul srang brgya/ 'bri gnyis/ g.yag gnyis/ mdzo gnyis/ mdzo mo gnyis/ chibs rta gcig chibs rol gnyis/ drel gcig mdzod btags bcas rnam grangs don gsum/ ༈ yang gdung rus bkru bar phebs dus mdzod btags/ spos phor rgyab zo legs pa/ ling yug gos yug dngul srang bcu/ ༈ phyag mdzod bla ma shes rab bzang po la/ dar kha/ ras yug wa lpags/

gzig lpags/ mdzo bcas/ gzhan zhabs phyi grwa 'khor rnams la 'bul ba 'os bstun/ ༈ mgo zi e waṃ khang gsar gyi zhabs drung rin po cher/ kha btag sman yug ras yug gsum/ gos yug wa/ spyang*/ g.yi/ gzig rnams kyi pags pa/ rdor dril/ thod ḍā/ lding ga ra bcas bcu gsum/ ༈ gdan sa gong gi chos rje rin po che phur pa bla mar/ kha btags/ ling yug gos yug ras yug gzig lpags/ g.yi lpags/ wa lpags/ rta pho/ dngul srang bcu bcas dgu/ ༈ bla ma kun dga' bsam gtan la/ dar kha/ ras yug wa lpags/ gzig lpags/ gsol zhal/ gos rdo rje sa lam gyi lcags ri can gzan/ dbus l+h+wam bcas bdun tshan/ yang zhal chems kyi gos stod/ grwa par/ dar kha/ wa lpags/ ༈ dgon chen rong por/ dar kha/ ther ser yug dngul srang lnga/ ras yug gnyis/ la khra mdzo bcas/ ༈ chos rje rgyal mtshan dbon po la/ dar kha/ ras yug ther ser/ dngul srang gsum/ a ti bcas lnga tshan/ ༈ gzhi sde chos rjer/ kha btags/ ther dril/ ras yug gos yug dngul srang bco lnga/ la khra/ g.yag mdzo bcas/ grwa par dar/ ras cha/ ༈ rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin phrin las dbang phyug drung du/ kha 'thag gos yug ling yug ras yug sman tse/ dngul srang bcu/ 'ga' khra bcas/ ༈ dpal spungs dbon sprul la/ dar kha/ dngul srang lnga/ gos yug ling yug ras yug gnyis/ rdzab phor bcas bdun tshan/ ༈ mkhar nang dbon bla mar stod tshe/ kha btags/ rgya dril/ gos kha/ li sder bcas/ mkhar bla rgan la/ kha btags/ spen par/ g.yi lpags/ ༈ nub mgon blar/ kha btags/ stod 'gags/ rgya dril/ gos sum 'brel/ ras yug gnyis/ li sder/ ༈ shar mgon blar/ kha btags/ gos kha/ rdor dril/ stod 'gags/ li sder bcas/ ༈ dbu mdzad gnyis la/ rdor dril re/ phyag ḍam re/ kha btags re/ dbus l+h+wam re/ li sder re bcas/ ༈ kun dga' bsam chen la/ kha btags/ dbus l+h+wam/ ting shags/ li sder/ ༈ dpe war dgon la/ ltung bshags smon lam khri 'don rten/ spyang*/ wa/ g.yi/ gzig lpags/ ༈ dpe war bla ma la/

dar kha/ dbus l+h+wam/ 'ga' khra/ ༈ rdo khor bla ma la de mtshungs/ ༈ bla ma lhun grub ting 'dzin la/ dar kha/ ting shags/ bu har sogs l+h+wam/ ༈ kun dga' shes rab la/ dar kha/ ting shags/ ༈ bla chung bzhi la/ kha btags bzhi/ li tir bzhi/ ༈ gsol dgung bdag po bdun bcu la/ dar legs pa re/ bal ṭaṃ re/ sham thabs gcig phrug gzan/ bu har sogs l+h+wam/ li tir/ mdzo bzhi/ g.yag gsum/ ༈ sde dge sku zhabs rnam rgyal grwa tshang la/ dar kha/ phrug dmar khra/ ༈ grwa tshang bla chos gsum la/ dar kha/ wa lpags re/ ༈ sgrub mchod mang tshogs la/ nyin gcig bcu ja re/ nyin gsum yon la/ phrug gzan spu hrug legs pa gnyis/ ra 'be ring thung yug bzhi/ mgo snam kha do/ ther ma gsum/ phrug ser khra/ sga srab cha tshang stan phyi nang gsum bcas/ yang sga srab ko stan cha tshang*/ gser srab smed/ bu lag ko phyed/ rgyal dam ko phyed/ phrug snam nag khra bubs gsum/ dmar khra gnyis/ rta gnyis/ ༈ zul rgyud dgon khag gsum la ther ma ser khra yug gnyis/ bstod tshe bcas/ dngul srang phyed bcu gsum/ ༈ sga len steng rong rgan chos rje la/ dar kha/ ras yug wa/ spyang*/ g.yi/ gzig dngul srang lnga bcas bdun tshan/ ༈ sga len steng chos rje rong gsar la/ dar kha/ ras yug wa lpags/ ༈ sga len steng dgon dpon bla mar/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ ༈ rdzong chen mgo'i bla ma rgya mtshor/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ srin thag yug wa lpags/ ༈ mkhar mdo dgon la/ phrug dkar khra/ dngul srang bcu bzhi/ ༈ mkhar mdo'i chos rje gnyis la/ dar kha/ ras yug rdor dril/ cha re/ ༈ dbon stod dgon la/ phrug dmar khra/ stod 'gags/ gtor cha/ dngul srang bcu gnyis/ ༈ ye na dgon la/ phrug ser thig dril bu gnyis/ dngul srang bcu gnyis/ ༈ rab brtan dgon la/ phrug sang khra/ yi sder drug gtor cha/ dngul srang bcu gnyis/ ༈ lcags ra dgon la/ gtsang phrug 'ga' khra/ dngul srang bcu bzhi/ ༈ sa kho chos rjer/ dar kha/ ras yug ther dril/ ༈ rdzong ltag chos rjer/ kha btags/ 'ga' khra yug ༈ 'dzom thog dgon par/

srin thag yug rdor dril cha gnyis/ dngul srang bcu gnyis/ ༈ 'dzom thog chos rjer/ dar kha/ ras yug rdor dril/ ༈ rdzong gsar dgon la/ ras sman tse ris/ li sder gnyis theb bcas/ dril bu gnyis/ dngul srang bcu gcig ༈ lha bya dgon la/ dngul srang bcu drug ༈ bla ma rab dkar la/ dar kha/ ljon gyi gtor cha/ dung phreng rgyun bgrang rgyan ldan/ ༈ rag chos dgon la/ dngul srang bcu drug ༈ rag chos rjer/ dar kha/ phud kong*/ rdor dril/ ༈ 'jam dbyangs sprul skur/ dar kha/ phud kong*/ rdor dril/ ༈ stobs ldan la/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ ༈ sa dkar dgon la dngul srang bcu drug chos rjer/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ phud kong*/ ༈ tshe bh+rūṃ sprul skur/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ ༈ rab kram dbon por/ dar kha/ rdor dril/ rag sder pad ma kha/ ༈ lhun grub steng lha gnyer bcu la bdun gcig par smon lam tshar re gsung yon/ rdor dril/ zo khra/ ༈ ting 'dzin rnam rgyal dar kha/ rgya phor rtsi ma/ wa lpags/ mdzo/ gdung rus 'dul mi la/ dar kha/ ras yug wa lpags/ ༈ sku 'dra sāts+tsha 'debs mi gnyis la/ dar kha/ ras yug re/ ༈ rgyab chog bskang gso dge slong so lnga dang gsol kha gnyis la yon ja 'khor drug gcig ༈ khang brtsegs mchod rten la dpon slob bdun gyis rab gnas la/ bla mar dar kha/ ras yug wa lpags/ dge slong drug la dar kha re/ bal ṭaṃ re phul/ ༈ sa ngor la mchod 'bul bsngo smon zhu rten mtshon byed la thog mar 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dpal sa skya'i gong ma rdo rje 'chang chen zhabs pad du/ mdzod btags/ ling yug gos rgyan bzhi yug dngul srang brgya/ lha rigs 'jam dpal gzhon nu gdung rgyud rin po che sku mched zhabs drung du mdzod btags/ ling yug gos gser jus sngon po yug dngul srang lnga bcu/ sa skyar mang ja rten dngul srang brgyad/ ༈ e waṃ bla brang du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa pa chen po mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag khang gsar mkhan rin po cher mdzod btags/

ling yug gos yug dngul srang nyer lnga/ bla brang khang gsar zhabs drung rin po cher mdzod btags/ gos yug dngul srang nyi shu/ bla brang klu sdings zhabs drung rin po cher mdzod btags/ gos yug dngul srang nyi shu/ bla brang thar rtse'i zhabs drung rin po cher mdzod btags/ gos yug dngul srang bco lnga/ phan bde khang sku dbon rin po cher mdzod btags/ gos yug dngul srang nyi shu/ khang ser dbon rin po cher mdzod btags/ gos yug dngul srang bcu/ bsnyen rgyas gnyis kyi rten la dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu bcas phul/ chos

bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan/ dbyings bde ba chen por rtag rol thugs// nyi tshe'i mchod pa'i re dogs las 'das kyang*// rjes 'jug bsod nams tshogs chen gsog pa'i thabs// rten 'brel tshul 'di khyod kyi thugs rjer khums// srid mtha' dag gzugs can/ 'byor nyes pa'i rtsa ba gser dgra'i khams// thabs mkhas mchod sbyin dngul chu'i sbyor ba yis// byang chen snying pos lci ba'i su war+ṇar// sgyur byed stobs bcu'i gser 'gyur mkhan gyi 'phrul// de slad mtshungs gsal gyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan/ mchog dman yul la bdog pa'i dngos// gtong ba'i sor mo gcig tu ma bskums pa// srid pa'i mig gi mdza' bas nyer bzung ba'i// pad dkar gzhon nu'i 'dab ma'i gzugs kyi zla// mkhas grub yan lag gsum gzugs/ rinaṃ cheṃn gser gyi 'khor lo yis// thub bstan rgyal srid miṃ 'gyuṃr rdzogs ldan dpal// sa gsum phyogs las rnam rgyalaṃ ya mtshaṃn du// 'dzin mdzad mkhan chen sngon med mān+dhā ta// bslab gsum nyer zhi bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ dul ba'i dpal gyis mdzes// thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul la thugs rab gzhung*// rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la rtag gzhol ba'i// rnam 'dren chosaṃ bzhin smra ba'i rjeṃr gyur maṃng*// rigaṃ groṃl sems med rab rtog bzhin skra can/ 'duṃs paṃ'i ngur smrig tshon mdangs kyis// nor ldan bzhin ras bsgyur ba'i ngo mtshar gyis// thub bstan snyigs mar smra rnams brdzun pa'i mtshang*// mthong bas sems med chu skyes dgod pa bzhin// de kun rmongs pa'i dpe/ brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag bzhes kyi// 'khrul med bsgrubaṃ phrinaṃ bstaraṃ tshe dpyod ldan kun// 'phags yul paṇa grub tshogs su rnam brtags te// dzā ti'i sman ljongs las brtsams bsngags pas brel// tshur mthong bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/

sgyu ma'i sku brnyan ye shes mes// bzhus pa'i snyigs ma rdo rje'i phra rab rdul// byin rlabs sāṃts+tshaṃr bsgrubaṃ pa sku bal bcas// 'brel tshad lus can thar pa'i gsos mchog tu// dri med sh+lau ka gsum chos dpe/ lung bzhin khaṃng brtseṃg chos sku'i rten// ring bsrel rnam bzhir bcas pas gtams pa la// byin rlabs phung por bsgrub pa'i ya mtshan ni// rgyal kun thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin// slar yang dbuṃs gtsaṃng dag pa'i zhing khams su// rnam 'dren bzhi pa bzo yi sprul pa'i skur// gzugs gzhan bsgyur bzhin gangs can gdul bya'i dpal// joṃ shākaṃ rnamaṃ gnyiṃs gtsos pa'i rten mchog dang*// gang gi rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar gyi// grags pas saṃ gsum zla shel ltar skyaṃ bar// ngagaṃ dbaṃng sgyu 'phrul mkhas kunaṃ dgaṃ' skyed kyi// bloṃ groṃs mtshungs med 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i mgon// chos yan lag gcig gzugs/ phung brgyad khri'i gleng gzhi eṃ waṃ gyis// nyer mtshan 'og min gnyis pa'i rdo rje khrir// ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug dam pa'i choṃs skyongaṃ ba'i// mkhas btsun bzaṃng po'iṃ khyu mchog mtshungs med sogs/ /dpe las dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can/ gang la yud tsam brten pas sgrib gsum dpung*// zad par za ba'i mthu nus rdzogs pa yis// lus kyi dri ma 'khrud pa'i gaṅgā las// dag byed khyad par byas pa'i mchod yul rnams// yo byung ba 'gog pa/ byad phra mo'i bkur stis phan bde'i 'bras// rgya chen thob pa'i gtam 'di ci lta bu// 'on te zhing bsam dngos po rnam dag gi /bsod nams gzhal med drang srong chen po'i bka'// de las chos dpe/ khyad par nang gi mchoṃd pa'i rtenaṃ// nyes pa'i gdung sel ti la par+ṇī las// bkraṃ shiṃs sgoṃ 'phar maṃng po'i bzo khyad ni// sna tshogs las pa sa 'dir 'ongs pa bzhin// yon tan

bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ dpag yas ston mchog 'phel gdung gtsos// sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang rjes 'brel ba'i// don gnyis dgos 'byung ring bsrel tsa twā raḥ /brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med kyis gtams pa// ye shes 'khor gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba/ lo 'jug pa'i cho ga yis// rgyal rnams gsang gsum ngo bor bsgrub 'di las// bde gshegs sku dngos tshur mthong yul 'das phyir// skal bzang skye dgus legs byas 'dir 'bungs shig /ces pa de dag rnams kyis ni bdag sogs lus can 'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen nam/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes yongs su grags pa gang de'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i kha 'gengs ci ltar rigs pa bkod zin nas slar yang smras pa/ swa sti sid+dhir+bha ban+tu/ rgyal rnams sprul gzhi ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bsngags pa yan lag gcig gzugs/ ye shes dag pa'i me long sgrib bral ngos// sems can khams rnams gang gis ji ltar gdul ba'i tshul// gzigs pa dus las yol ba mi mnga'i rang bzhin gyi// rdzu 'phrul bkod pa tshur mthong blo yi yul las brgal// thub mchog sku phreng gong ma rnams la bsngags pa rab spel/ bstan la ston pa gnyis pa zhi ba 'tsho// lnga rig paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal 'jam dpal grags// mkhas btsun bzang ldan mtshungs bral sangs rgyas lha dbang sogs// bsam bzhin dag pa'i yang srid brgyud pa tshar du dngar// rigs rus la bsngags pa mtha' dag gzugs/ e ma mdo khams 'chi med dga' tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan// 'phrul mdzangs ya rabs zhaṃng pa'iṃ rigs kyi sa bon las// gtsug lag gnyis ldan leṃgs bshaṃd rtsa ba ches brtan las// don gnyis re skong dpag bsam dbang po 'di 'khrungs sam// cha

sku chung ngu'i skabs kyi dam pa'i yon tan la bsngags pa mchog gi nges bstan/ shas phra mo nyid kyang kun la bsil sbyin zhing*// dpal mgrin gtsug tor rtser 'dzegs zla tshes gsar pa 'dis// gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i yon tan lhun grub cing*// blo ldan yongs kyis spyi bor bkur ba'i tshul 'di ston// gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi thugs bcud khyod gcig gi /bgo skal las gzhan phal gyis myong ba ci zhig lta// dbyar gyi bcud len brtas pa'i dri bzang khang pa'i bcud// blang byar shes pa sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs las gzhan su// stong pa'i bstan la bya ba mdzad tshul 'gal ba'i gzugs can/ mkha' la shing rta bdun gyis drangs pa med// bcu gnyis khyim du dga' mar brtse ba yang min pa'i// bcu phrag rig smra gang gi phrin las nyi gzhon gyis// thub bstan 'khrul pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bcad cing bkrus// yid 'ong gsung phyi so thar gyi tshul rmad byung gi dpe/ ldang bung ba rgyags pa'i snyan dbyangs can// dmar ser tshon gyi mtshar sdug gur gum dga' tshal zhig /tshul khrims dri dang legs bshad chos kyi sgra 'byin na// 'dul 'dzin khyu mchog gang gi bslab zhi'i rjes su 'gro// ma la byang chub thugs bskyed 'byongs pa smad pa'i dpe/ ya rlung bsil yang srid nyon yid srub bskyed// pad dkar 'dab ma mnyen yang dus kyis mi sdug 'gyur// de dag las ni rgyal sras khyod kyi rmad byung gi /byang chub spyod mchog 'gran zla med pa'i khyad par byas// bde chen gsang sngags la nang byan chud pa kun phan gyi rgyan/ snying po 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi// mtshan nyid de ni ci lta zhig ces som nyi'i tshe// 'di las gzhan du dmigs su med ces mgon khyod tshul// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i khrod na yi ge'i gzugs kyis sgeg

/ 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis ka'i ldog pa can/ mtho ris klung dang khyod kyi legs bshad 'chad pa'i gsung*// 'gro ba kun gyis dag byed tshad mar gyur pa ste// de ni lam srol gsum du nye bar gzhol byed cing*// legs gsung mgon khyod dpal gyi mgur las rtag par 'jo// phyogs rtsod pa'i tshul mi 'os pa'i cha/ las rnam rgyal gang gi lung rigs mdun sa na// dregs ldan rgol ngan mtha' dag mgo bo dud pa'i mig /nor 'dzin gzhi la blta de kye ma rmongs pa'i lus// sa chen rdul snyed 'di tsam blangs zhes ston las ci// snang sh+lau ka gnyis brtsam pa la bsngags pa'i dang po bya ba thog gsal/ bar byas so phyogs kun nyin mor byed pa'i gzis// brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bus rnam sad gzhal med khang*// gong gi dri med rig pa'i lam las nyer drangs pa'i// 'chos skyob mtshan nyid ldan pas rgyal bstan ma lus pa// 'khor gnyis pa rgyus 'gog pa/ 'das chos kun sgra don gal tshig rgyan gsum gyi// lam du song ba thogs med 'jo la mi bsngags te// bcu drug rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i dbus su mtsho ldan ma// dgyes par rol nas smra la dka' ba ci zhig mchis// nang du srid pa'i mthu nus la bsngags pa nyams byed kyi rgyu/ nyer len gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i sgra// rim gnyis zab mo'i lam gyi sgyu thabs grangs med kyis// bcom pas phyi rol gzugs can gzugs med glags lta'i tshogs// bden tshig tsam gyis ming gi lhag ma nyid du mdzad// dag snang 'khor yug gi tshul khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ snang grags rig pa lha sngags ye shes yongs smin la// dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las gzhan ci zhig 'char// thabs mkhas ded dpon bum pa brgya skyes gling phyin pas// phal pa'i gseg ma btsal kyang rnyed pa'i gtam ma mchis// rdo rje'i chos srung chos srung bran du 'khol ba rgyus 'gog pa/

rgyud gsum dregs pas ci bgyi'i bka'// bran bzhin bsgrub la ya mtshan ched du mi bsngags te// rgyal rnams spyan sngar bstan 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// tha tshig snying po 'di las gzhan pa'i bsgrub bya gang*// lam gyi thugs dam khor yug gi tshul da ltar ba 'gog pa/ gang zag phal bzhin zab mo'i bzlas bsgom la// nyin bzhin brtson pa gzhar yang mi lhod 'di ci zhig /bstan 'gro'i don du bsam bzhin srid pa gzung ba las// spangs rtogs dpal kun sngon nas brnyes pa min nam ci// mkhas phrin las bstan 'gror sman tshul byung ba 'gog pa/ tshul gsum gyis bstan 'gror sman mdzad phrin las kyi// cha shas re yang bskal par brjod pas rdzogs min gang*// klu ri'i bgrang byar grub pa'i gtam 'di srid dam ci// 'on kyang 'phags chen dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul su yis rtogs// dregs ldan che dgus gtsug gis mchod pa chos 'gog pa/ lha brgyas nor bu'i rna cha g.yo ldan gyi// thor tshugs grol bas khyod kyi zhabs rdul brten byed 'dis// 'gro ba kun la bran gyur bzhin du phan bzhed kyi// thugs dam 'di ci ya ma brla ru ma gyur grang*// bstan 'dzin bu slob spel ba dpe rgyan mtshungs gsal gyi sgras zin/ gdul bya'i skal bar 'tshams pa'i chos tshul thun mong dang*// khyad par mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi'i// bstan srog mthud pa'i sku drin gyis bskyangs zhal slob tshogs// mkhas btsun bzang dgu nam mkha'i skar phran grangs la 'phya// dus las myang 'das kyi tshul rgyu med pas 'bras bu yod pa bskyed pa/ yol dang skabs su ma bab skyod pa ni// mchog gi sar bzhugs 'phags pa rnams la yongs mi mnga'// de phyir sku dngos gdul bya re zhig rdzogs par brten// skye 'gag bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings su gzhol la phyogs// 'on kyang khyod kyi

sprul pa rgyun mi chad tshul gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa/ bstan 'gror sman mdzad phrin las rgyun// da dung 'byung ngam som nyir gyur rnams rgyal ba'i sras// bzod med brtse bas dus drug 'gro la gzigs rnams kyi// thugs bskyed brtul la nye'am dris dang des rtogs 'gyur// de ltar skyabs 'di man chad byas pa don yod phyir bsngo smon las thog mar mang ba'i dpe/ gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /rtogs brjod rgya mtsho'i mjings las skra rtse'i zegs ma tsam// bsngags pa'i legs byas zla ba'i 'od dang shaṃ kha laḥ /ka ra hā ṭa kha ba'i rdul bzhin rab dkar des// lus rgyu'i dpe/ can sdug bsngal zug rngu gzhom la sman mchog ste// phan bde'i snang ba gya nom sbyin pas nyi ma nyid// brgya lam na yang rnyed dkas u dum wā ra yi// rjes 'gror gyur pa'i thub bstan srid mthar mi nyams shog /de rim pa can gyi rgyan la dpe rgyan 'dres pa/ tshul 'dzin mdzad 'phags dang so skye ma nges tshul// gang dag bzhugs rnams sku tshe phrin las bzhed don bcas// rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'chi med lam gyi pha mtha' dang*// zla ba mthong ba'i chu gter dpal la 'gran gyur cig /khyad par rnam sh+lau ka gnyis yan lag gcig gzugs/ 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs dri med rgyun// ji bzhin 'doms la 'gran bral brtse chen snying po'i zhabs// rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi// ring lugs nor bu skye dgu'i gtsug na gsal gyur cig /ngagaṃ tshig dbaṃng pos bsngags pa'i mthas gtugs rgyal kunaṃ gyi// dgaṃ' chen ye shes bloṃ groṃs bdag po gzugs gzhan pa'i// yab sras rnam gsum zhabs sen 'char ka'i dmar ba'i rdul// sa gsum 'gro ba'i gtsug tu g.yo med brtan gyur cig /thub gsum gzugs/ bstan riṃn cheṃn mchog tu miṃ 'gyuraṃ brtan byed kyi// bshad sgrub rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn thugs bskyed phrag par ches brling ba'i// rgyal ba'i myu gu shar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin nyid du 'tsho gzhes gsol// mdo

bai dar+bha'i mdzes pa bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ rgyud man ngag mkhyen pa'i dbaṃng phyug choṃs smra'i gtso// lus can phan bder skyongaṃ ba'i phrin las bzaṃng poṃ'i khyon// srid mthar khyab gang thub mchog zhal skyin e waṃ pa'i// bstan pa'i btsas su zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan gyur cig / mtha' dag gzugs can/ khyad par chos 'dul tshulaṃ khrimaṃs dri bsung phyogs mthar 'thul// bsdu dngos phar phyin lo ma stug ldan bsil yang 'jo// mtshan rtog las skyob sku bzhi'i rinaṃ cheṃn 'bras dud pa'i// skyabs mchog yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i zab dgongs yongs rdzogs shog /de mthus yan lag gcig gzugs/ bdag kyang skye bar sdom gsum dag pa'i rten// mtshan ldan bla mas mnyes pa chen pos rjes bzung bas// thos bsam bsgom pas rgyud phyug rgyal bstan rin chen la// sri zhur bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs gyur cig /lha mi'i yan lag gnyis gzugs/ sdeṃ kun dgeṃ bcu'i khrims kyis bder skyong bas// nyer mtshon chos ldan sa skyong sku tshe bstan srid rgyas// yangs pa'i 'jig rten rdzogs ldan brtse dga'i g.yas 'khyil sgras// snyigs spyod mi ngas srid mthar bros snyam byed gyur cig /bkra shis gang grangs kyi gab tshig zhig dge legs dpal gyis mngon par gdug pa'i bkra shis ri mo gsum pa'i gnas nas stong phrag bzhi yis nyer lhag pa'i// bkra shis grangs kyi khri phrag bdud rtsi thog mtha' bar gyi bkra shis 'dzin pa rig grol gnyis ldan thun mong bstan bya'i rin chen gsum// bkra shis phul byung sku gsung thugs ni stobs bcu'i dbang phyug bkra shis gsum ldan tshogs mchog kun 'dus gdan gsum 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mchog /bkra shis yongs kyi 'byung gnas mtshungs med khyab bdag bla ma'i bkra shis dam pa srid zhi'i dge legs phun tshogs kun gyis 'jig rten khams su khyab gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje 'chang zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen nam ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi dgongs pa'i lhag ma skong ba dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi dad pa'i gsos su med du mi rung ba dang*/ gcig tu tshe rabs kun tu ngag 'khyal rgya mtsho lta bu bsags pa las/ da lam dam pa'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i brjod pa don dang ldan pa chu thigs tsam gyi skal bzang 'di dag la bsten nas skye bar dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i dgos pa khyad par can gyis rgyud dbang med du bskul/ khe grags rnyed dang bkur sti don du gnyer ba'i dri mas ma sbags par lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te rje btsun de nyid kyi rigs kyi dbon dang chos kyi sras su gyur pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub bam/ rten 'brel dgos ched du btags ming phyi nang gtsug lag sde snod smra ba mkhas pa'i nyi gzhon zhes bod pas/ rab byung chos 'khor gyi nang gsel myos byed kyi bgrang gzhi'i snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po 'chi med bla ma rgyal sar phebs pa'i nyin/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gnyis pa rje bla ma'i gzims chung du grub par bgyis pa dge legs rgya cher 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
